FILE: .github/workflows/build-release.yml
name: Build Release

run-name: Build Release ${{ inputs.version }} from ${{ inputs.ref }}

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to build, such as 2026.46.0'
        required: true
        type: string
      ref:
        description: 'Branch, tag or full commit hash to build'
        required: true
        default: 'master'
        type: string
  workflow_call:

jobs:
  Source:
    if: github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird'
    name: Source
    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404

    outputs:
      artifact-id: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact-id }}

    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      artifact-metadata: write

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref }}

      - name: Package
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          name="ladybird${RELEASE_VERSION:+-${RELEASE_VERSION}}"
          git archive --prefix= --add-virtual-file="${name}/REVISION:$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --prefix="${name}/" \
            --output="${name}-source.tar" HEAD
          xz -9 -T0 "${name}-source.tar"

      - name: Attest
        if: ${{ inputs.version != '' }}
        uses: actions/attest@v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: '*-source.tar.xz'

      - name: Upload
        id: upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: '*-source.tar.xz'
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

  Build:
    if: github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird'
    name: ${{ matrix.system }}, ${{ matrix.arch }}, Distribution, Clang
    needs: Source
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(matrix.runner_labels) }}
    container: ${{ fromJSON(matrix.container) }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - system: 'macOS'
            os_name: 'macOS'
            arch: 'arm64'
            runner_labels: '["blacksmith-12vcpu-macos-26"]'
            container: 'null'
            archives: true

          - system: 'Ubuntu 24.04'
            os_name: 'Linux'
            arch: 'x86_64'
            runner_labels: '["blacksmith-16vcpu-ubuntu-2404"]'
            container: &noble_container '{"image":"docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04","options":"--ulimit core=1"}'
            packages: 'DEB'
            appimage: true

          - system: 'Ubuntu 24.04'
            os_name: 'Linux'
            arch: 'arm64'
            runner_labels: '["blacksmith-16vcpu-ubuntu-2404-arm"]'
            container: *noble_container
            packages: 'DEB'
            appimage: true

          - system: 'Ubuntu 26.04'
            os_name: 'Linux'
            arch: 'x86_64'
            runner_labels: '["blacksmith-16vcpu-ubuntu-2404"]'
            container: &ci_container '{"image":"ghcr.io/ladybirdbrowser/ladybird-ci:2026.11.21","options":"--ulimit core=1"}'
            packages: 'DEB'

          - system: 'Ubuntu 26.04'
            os_name: 'Linux'
            arch: 'arm64'
            runner_labels: '["blacksmith-16vcpu-ubuntu-2404-arm"]'
            container: *ci_container
            packages: 'DEB'

          - system: 'Fedora 44'
            os_name: 'Linux'
            arch: 'x86_64'
            runner_labels: '["blacksmith-16vcpu-ubuntu-2404"]'
            container: '{"image":"docker.io/library/fedora:44","options":"--ulimit core=1"}'
            packages: 'RPM'

          - system: 'Fedora 44'
            os_name: 'Linux'
            arch: 'arm64'
            runner_labels: '["blacksmith-16vcpu-ubuntu-2404-arm"]'
            container: '{"image":"docker.io/library/fedora:44","options":"--ulimit core=1"}'
            packages: 'RPM'

    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      artifact-metadata: write

    steps:
      - name: Download the source
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8.0.2
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.Source.outputs.artifact-id }}

      - name: Install xz to unpack the source
        if: ${{ startsWith(matrix.system, 'Ubuntu') && !contains(matrix.container, 'ladybird-ci') }}
        run: |
          apt-get update -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any
          apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends xz-utils

      - name: Unpack the source
        run: |
          tar -xf ./*-source.tar.xz --strip-components=1
          rm ./*-source.tar.xz

      - name: Install the build dependencies
        if: ${{ matrix.os_name == 'Linux' && !contains(matrix.container, 'ladybird-ci') }}
        run: ./Meta/Docker/ci/install-build-dependencies.sh

      - name: Build
        uses: $/.github/actions/build
        with:
          os: ${{ matrix.os_name }}
          arch: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          toolchain: 'Clang'
          build_preset: 'Distribution'
          version: ${{ inputs.version }}
          use_caches: false

      - name: Package
        if: ${{ matrix.archives }}
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}/Build
        run: |
          cpack -G TXZ -B packages -D CPACK_COMPONENTS_ALL="ladybird_Runtime;ladybird_Symbols" \
            -D CPACK_ARCHIVE_COMPRESSION_LEVEL=9 -D CPACK_COMPONENT_INCLUDE_TOPLEVEL_DIRECTORY=ON

      - name: Package for ${{ matrix.system }}
        if: ${{ matrix.packages }}
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}/Build
        run: |
          cpack -G "${{ matrix.packages }}" -B packages \
            -D CPACK_COMPONENTS_ALL="ladybird_Runtime;ladybird_SystemIntegration;ladybird_SystemSymbols"

      # The AppImage is built on Ubuntu 24.04, the oldest system that Ladybird builds for, so that it runs on systems with
      # the same glibc or newer.
      - name: Package the AppImage
        if: ${{ matrix.appimage && inputs.version != '' }}
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: ./Meta/package-appimage.sh Build "$RELEASE_VERSION" "$ARCH" Build/packages

      # release-tools publishes the source archive of every LGPL port at the address that LICENSES.txt names.
      - name: Package the source code of the LGPL libraries
        if: ${{ inputs.version != '' }}
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}/Build
        shell: bash
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          SYSTEM: ${{ matrix.system }}
          ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
        run: |
          cmake --build . --target third_party_sources
          mkdir -p packages
          mv third-party-sources.tar "packages/ladybird-${RELEASE_VERSION}-${SYSTEM// /-}-${ARCH}-third-party-sources.tar"

      - name: Attest
        if: ${{ inputs.version != '' }}
        uses: actions/attest@v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            Build/packages/*.tar.xz
            Build/packages/*.deb
            Build/packages/*.rpm
            Build/packages/*.AppImage
            Build/packages/*-third-party-sources.tar

      - name: Upload
        if: ${{ matrix.archives }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: |
            Build/packages/ladybird-*.tar.xz
            !Build/packages/ladybird-symbols-*.tar.xz
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload debug symbols
        if: ${{ matrix.archives }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: Build/packages/ladybird-symbols-*.tar.xz
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload the Debian package
        if: ${{ matrix.packages == 'DEB' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: Build/packages/ladybird_*.deb
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload the Debian debug symbols
        if: ${{ matrix.packages == 'DEB' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: Build/packages/ladybird-dbgsym_*.deb
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload the RPM package
        if: ${{ matrix.packages == 'RPM' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: |
            Build/packages/ladybird-*.rpm
            !Build/packages/ladybird-debuginfo-*.rpm
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload the RPM debug symbols
        if: ${{ matrix.packages == 'RPM' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: Build/packages/ladybird-debuginfo-*.rpm
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload the AppImage
        if: ${{ matrix.appimage && inputs.version != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: Build/packages/ladybird-*.AppImage
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload the source code of the LGPL libraries
        if: ${{ inputs.version != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: Build/packages/ladybird-*-third-party-sources.tar
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Start PulseAudio
        if: ${{ matrix.os_name == 'Linux' }}
        run: |
          echo "PULSE_SERVER=unix:/tmp/pulse-native" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          pulseaudio --system -D --exit-idle-time=1800 \
            --load="module-native-protocol-unix auth-anonymous=1 socket=/tmp/pulse-native" \
            --load="module-null-sink sink_name=virtual_sink"

      - name: Test
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: ctest --parallel --output-on-failure --test-dir Build --timeout 1800

      - name: Upload LibWeb Test Artifacts
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          name: libweb-test-artifacts-${{ matrix.system }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-Distribution
          path: Build/Tests/LibWeb/test-web/test-dumps/
          retention-days: 0
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  Flatpak:
    if: github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird'
    name: Flatpak, ${{ matrix.arch }}
    needs: Source
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(matrix.runner_labels) }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: 'x86_64'
            runner_labels: '["blacksmith-16vcpu-ubuntu-2404"]'
          - arch: 'aarch64'
            runner_labels: '["blacksmith-16vcpu-ubuntu-2404-arm"]'

    container:
      image: ghcr.io/flathub-infra/flatpak-github-actions:kde-6.10
      options: --privileged

    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      artifact-metadata: write

    env:
      BUNDLE: ladybird-${{ inputs.version && format('{0}-', inputs.version) }}Linux-${{ matrix.arch }}.flatpak
      DEBUG_BUNDLE: ladybird-${{ inputs.version && format('{0}-', inputs.version) }}Linux-${{ matrix.arch }}-debug.flatpak
      THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES: ladybird-${{ inputs.version }}-Flatpak-${{ matrix.arch }}-third-party-sources.tar

    steps:
      - name: Download the source
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8.0.2
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.Source.outputs.artifact-id }}

      - name: Unpack the source
        run: |
          tar -xf ./*-source.tar.xz --strip-components=1
          rm ./*-source.tar.xz

      # The image bakes the SDK into a read-only layer, and the action always has flatpak-builder update it from
      # Flathub. An update renames the old deployment into /var/lib/flatpak/.removed, and overlayfs can't rename a
      # directory that lives in a lower layer (EXDEV), so whenever Flathub carries a newer SDK than the image, the
      # build dies before compiling anything. Copying the installation up into the writable layer first (about 5 GB,
      # some 15 seconds) makes that rename an ordinary one, whatever Flathub has published since the image was built.
      - name: Make the baked-in Flatpak installation writable
        run: |
          cp -a /var/lib/flatpak /var/lib/flatpak.rw
          rm -rf /var/lib/flatpak
          mv /var/lib/flatpak.rw /var/lib/flatpak

      - name: Set the version in the manifest
        if: ${{ inputs.version != '' }}
        env:
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'SCRIPT'
          import json
          import os

          path = "Meta/CMake/flatpak/org.ladybird.Ladybird.json"
          with open(path) as file:
              manifest = json.load(file)
          ladybird = next(module for module in manifest["modules"] if module["name"] == "Ladybird")
          ladybird["config-opts"].append(f"-DLADYBIRD_VERSION={os.environ['RELEASE_VERSION']}")
          with open(path, "w") as file:
              json.dump(manifest, file, indent=4)
          SCRIPT

      - name: Build
        uses: flatpak/flatpak-github-actions/flatpak-builder@v6.8
        with:
          bundle: ${{ env.BUNDLE }}
          build-debug-bundle: true
          manifest-path: Meta/CMake/flatpak/org.ladybird.Ladybird.json
          arch: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          cache: false
          upload-artifact: false

      # release-tools publishes the source archive of every LGPL module with the release.
      - name: Package the source code of the LGPL libraries
        if: ${{ inputs.version != '' }}
        run: |
          python3 Meta/generate-licenses.py --flatpak-manifest Meta/CMake/flatpak/org.ladybird.Ladybird.json \
            --third-party-sources "$THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES"

      - name: Attest
        if: ${{ inputs.version != '' }}
        uses: actions/attest@v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            ${{ env.BUNDLE }}
            ${{ env.DEBUG_BUNDLE }}
            ${{ env.THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES }}

      - name: Upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: ${{ env.BUNDLE }}
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload debug symbols
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: ${{ env.DEBUG_BUNDLE }}
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload the source code of the LGPL libraries
        if: ${{ inputs.version != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          path: ${{ env.THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES }}
          archive: false
          if-no-files-found: error

FILE: .github/workflows/ci-image.yml
name: Build CI Image

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/ci-image.yml'
      - 'Meta/Docker/ci/**'
      - 'rust-toolchain.toml'
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/ci-image.yml'
      - 'Meta/Docker/ci/**'
      - 'rust-toolchain.toml'
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # Keep image build breakage visible before dependency changes block regular CI.
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1'

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

env:
  IMAGE_NAME: ghcr.io/ladybirdbrowser/ladybird-ci

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird'
    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404

    outputs:
      ci_image_version: ${{ steps.ci-image-version.outputs.ci_image_version }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Read image version
        id: ci-image-version
        shell: bash
        run: |
          ci_image_version="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < Meta/Docker/ci/VERSION)"
          if ! [[ "${ci_image_version}" =~ ^[0-9]{4}\.[0-9]{2}\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
            echo "Invalid CI image version: ${ci_image_version}"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "ci_image_version=${ci_image_version}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Require version bump for Dockerfile changes
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          changed_files="$(git diff --name-only "${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}...HEAD")"
          if grep -Eqx 'Meta/Docker/ci/Dockerfile|Meta/Docker/ci/install-build-dependencies.sh|rust-toolchain.toml' <<< "${changed_files}" \
            && ! grep -qx 'Meta/Docker/ci/VERSION' <<< "${changed_files}"; then
            echo "Meta/Docker/ci/VERSION must change when CI image inputs change."
            exit 1
          fi

  build:
    if: github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird'
    needs: prepare
    name: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: linux/amd64
            runner: blacksmith-8vcpu-ubuntu-2404
            arch_suffix: amd64
          - platform: linux/arm64
            runner: blacksmith-8vcpu-ubuntu-2404-arm
            arch_suffix: arm64

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - name: Prepare Docker context
        shell: bash
        run: cp rust-toolchain.toml Meta/Docker/ci/rust-toolchain.toml

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        uses: docker/login-action@v4.8.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4.4.1

      - name: Build and publish image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v7.4.0
        with:
          context: Meta/Docker/ci
          file: Meta/Docker/ci/Dockerfile
          platforms: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          push: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
          tags: |
            ${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ needs.prepare.outputs.ci_image_version }}-${{ matrix.arch_suffix }}
            ${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:sha-${{ github.sha }}-${{ matrix.arch_suffix }}
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/LadybirdBrowser/ladybird
            org.opencontainers.image.description=Ladybird Linux CI build image
            org.opencontainers.image.version=${{ needs.prepare.outputs.ci_image_version }}

  publish-manifest:
    if: github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird' && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch')
    needs: [prepare, build]
    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404

    steps:
      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v4.8.0
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4.4.1

      - name: Publish multi-arch manifests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          docker buildx imagetools create \
            --tag "${IMAGE_NAME}:${{ needs.prepare.outputs.ci_image_version }}" \
            --tag "${IMAGE_NAME}:sha-${{ github.sha }}" \
            --tag "${IMAGE_NAME}:latest" \
            "${IMAGE_NAME}:${{ needs.prepare.outputs.ci_image_version }}-amd64" \
            "${IMAGE_NAME}:${{ needs.prepare.outputs.ci_image_version }}-arm64"

name: CI

on:
  push:

  pull_request:

concurrency:

jobs:
  # CI matrix - runs the job in build-and-test.yml with different configurations.
  Lagom:
    if: github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird'

FILE: .github/workflows/collabskus-release.yml
# .github/workflows/collabskus-release.yml
#
# Builds self-contained Ladybird binaries on every push to master.
# Linux  → AppImage  (x86_64)
# macOS  → zipped .app bundle (arm64)
# Publishes a GitHub Release tagged build-YYYYMMDD-<short sha>.
#
# Fixes applied vs previous version:
#   - Removed ppa:ubuntu-toolchain-r/test (caused 504 timeout; not needed on ubuntu-24.04)
#   - ubuntu-24.04 already ships gcc-14; clang-21 comes from LLVM apt directly
#   - vcpkg bootstrap script is Meta/Utils/build_vcpkg.py (not Meta/BuildVcpkg.py)
#   - macOS: explicit brew link for llvm@21 so clang-21 is actually on PATH
#   - Updated all actions to Node 24-compatible versions (v5+)
#   - Linux: added -Wl,--start-group/--end-group linker flags to fix circular
#     dependency between liblagom-unicode and liblibunicode_rust.a
#   - macOS: replaced dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable with a direct rustup call to
#     avoid "detected conflict: bin/cargo-clippy" on macos-15 runners that ship
#     with Rust + clippy pre-installed; rustup update stable installs nothing new
#     when the component already exists, sidestepping the conflict entirely.

name: collabskus Build & Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  LLVM_VERSION: 21

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
jobs:

  # ── Linux x86_64 → AppImage ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  build-linux:
    name: Build Linux (x86_64)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: pip3 install pyyaml requests six

      - name: Install apt dependencies
        run: |
          # ── LLVM apt repo ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
          curl -fsSL https://apt.llvm.org/llvm-snapshot.gpg.key \
            | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/llvm-snapshot.gpg
          echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/llvm-snapshot.gpg] \
            http://apt.llvm.org/noble/ llvm-toolchain-noble-${LLVM_VERSION} main" \
            | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/llvm.list

          # ── Kitware (CMake 3.30+) ──────────────────────────────────────────
          wget -qO - https://apt.kitware.com/keys/kitware-archive-latest.asc \
            | gpg --dearmor \
            | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/kitware-archive-keyring.gpg >/dev/null
          echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/kitware-archive-keyring.gpg] \
            https://apt.kitware.com/ubuntu/ noble main" \
            | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/kitware.list

          sudo apt-get update -y

          # ubuntu-24.04 ships gcc-14 and g++-14 natively — no PPA needed
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            autoconf \
            autoconf-archive \
            automake \
            bison \
            build-essential \
            ccache \
            cmake \
            curl \
            fonts-liberation2 \
            g++-14 \
            gcc-14 \
            git \
            clang-${LLVM_VERSION} \
            clang++-${LLVM_VERSION} \
            clang-tools-${LLVM_VERSION} \
            lld-${LLVM_VERSION} \
            libdrm-dev \
            libgl1-mesa-dev \
            libegl1-mesa-dev \
            libpulse-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libstdc++-14-dev \
            libxkbcommon-dev \
            libtool \
            nasm \
            ninja-build \
            patchelf \
            pkg-config \
            tar \
            unzip \
            zip

          sudo update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/clang   clang   /usr/bin/clang-${LLVM_VERSION}   100
          sudo update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/clang++ clang++ /usr/bin/clang++-${LLVM_VERSION} 100
          sudo update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/lld     lld     /usr/bin/lld-${LLVM_VERSION}     100

          cmake --version
          clang --version
          ninja --version

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install Qt 6.9
        uses: jurplel/install-qt-action@v4
        with:
          version: '6.9.0'
          target: 'desktop'
          arch: 'gcc_64'

      - name: Configure (Distribution preset)
        run: |
          cmake --preset Distribution -B Build \
            -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-${LLVM_VERSION} \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++-${LLVM_VERSION} \
            -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="$Qt6_DIR" \
            -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-Wl,--start-group" \
            -DCMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS="" \
            -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-Wl,--start-group"

      - name: Install wasm-tools
        run: |
          VERSION=1.243.0
          curl -fsSL "https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/releases/download/v${VERSION}/wasm-tools-${VERSION}-x86_64-linux.tar.gz" \
            | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C /usr/local/bin \
              "wasm-tools-${VERSION}-x86_64-linux/wasm-tools"
          wasm-tools --version

      - name: Bootstrap vcpkg
        run: python3 Meta/Utils/build_vcpkg.py

      - name: Configure (Distribution preset)
        run: |
          # -Wl,--start-group/--end-group resolves the circular dependency between
          # liblagom-unicode (C++ side) and liblibunicode_rust.a (Rust side): the
          # Rust archive calls back into C symbols that are defined in a static lib
          # that appears earlier on the link line.  GNU ld resolves this with a
          # group; lld accepts the same flags.
          cmake --preset Distribution -B Build \
            -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang-${LLVM_VERSION} \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++-${LLVM_VERSION} \
            -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-Wl,--start-group" \
            -DCMAKE_STATIC_LINKER_FLAGS="" \
            -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-Wl,--start-group"

      - name: Build
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}/Build
        run: cmake --build . --parallel $(nproc)

      - name: Install into staging prefix
        run: cmake --install Build --strip --prefix ${{ github.workspace }}/AppDir/usr

      - name: Download linuxdeploy + Qt plugin
        run: |
          wget -q https://github.com/linuxdeploy/linuxdeploy/releases/download/continuous/linuxdeploy-x86_64.AppImage
          wget -q https://github.com/linuxdeploy/linuxdeploy-plugin-qt/releases/download/continuous/linuxdeploy-plugin-qt-x86_64.AppImage
          chmod +x linuxdeploy-x86_64.AppImage linuxdeploy-plugin-qt-x86_64.AppImage

      - name: Write desktop entry and icon
        run: |
          mkdir -p AppDir/usr/share/applications AppDir/usr/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps
          cat > AppDir/usr/share/applications/ladybird.desktop <<'DESKTOP'
          [Desktop Entry]
          Name=Ladybird
          Exec=Ladybird %u
          Icon=ladybird
          Type=Application
          Categories=Network;WebBrowser;
          MimeType=text/html;text/xml;application/xhtml+xml;x-scheme-handler/http;x-scheme-handler/https;
          DESKTOP
          ICON_SRC=$(find Build -name "*.png" 2>/dev/null | grep -i ladybird | head -1 || true)
          if [ -n "$ICON_SRC" ]; then
            cp "$ICON_SRC" AppDir/usr/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/ladybird.png
          else
            python3 -c "
          import base64
          open('AppDir/usr/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/ladybird.png','wb').write(
            base64.b64decode('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8BQDwADhQGAWjR9awAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==')
          )"
          fi

      - name: Build AppImage
        env:
          QMAKE: /usr/lib/qt6/bin/qmake6
        run: |
          COMMIT_SHORT="${GITHUB_SHA::8}"
          TIMESTAMP="$(date -u +%Y%m%d)"
          export VERSION="${TIMESTAMP}-${COMMIT_SHORT}"
          ./linuxdeploy-x86_64.AppImage --appdir AppDir --plugin qt --output appimage
          APPIMAGE=$(ls Ladybird*.AppImage 2>/dev/null | head -1 || ls *.AppImage | head -1)
          FINAL="Ladybird-${VERSION}-linux-x86_64.AppImage"
          mv "$APPIMAGE" "$FINAL"
          echo "APPIMAGE_PATH=${FINAL}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RELEASE_TAG=build-${VERSION}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Upload Linux artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: linux-appimage
          path: ${{ env.APPIMAGE_PATH }}
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Save release tag
        run: echo "${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}" > release-tag.txt

      - name: Upload release tag artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: release-tag
          path: release-tag.txt
          retention-days: 7

  # ── macOS arm64 → zipped .app bundle ──────────────────────────────────────
  build-macos:
    name: Build macOS (arm64)
    runs-on: macos-15

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: pip3 install pyyaml requests six

      - name: Install Homebrew dependencies
        run: |
          brew update
          brew install \
            autoconf \
            autoconf-archive \
            automake \
            bash \
            ccache \
            coreutils \
            libtool \
            llvm@${LLVM_VERSION} \
            nasm \
            ninja \
            pkg-config \
            qt \
            unzip

      - name: Link llvm@21 and add to PATH
        run: |
          # Unlink any conflicting llvm version first, then link ours
          brew unlink llvm 2>/dev/null || true
          brew link --force --overwrite llvm@${LLVM_VERSION}
          LLVM_BIN="$(brew --prefix llvm@${LLVM_VERSION})/bin"
          echo "${LLVM_BIN}" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          # Verify immediately
          "${LLVM_BIN}/clang" --version
          "${LLVM_BIN}/clang++" --version

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        # macos-15 runners ship with Rust + clippy pre-installed. Using
        # dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable causes "detected conflict: bin/cargo-clippy"
        # because the action unconditionally tries to add the clippy component.
        # Instead, we call rustup directly: `rustup update stable` refreshes the
        # toolchain without touching components that are already present, and
        # `rustup default stable` ensures cargo/rustc on PATH are the stable ones.
        run: |
          rustup update stable
          rustup default stable
          rustc --version
          cargo --version

      - name: Install wasm-tools
        run: |
          VERSION=1.243.0
          curl -fsSL "https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasm-tools/releases/download/v${VERSION}/wasm-tools-${VERSION}-aarch64-macos.tar.gz" \
            | tar -xz --strip-components=1 -C /usr/local/bin \
              "wasm-tools-${VERSION}-aarch64-macos/wasm-tools"
          wasm-tools --version

      - name: Bootstrap vcpkg
        run: python3 Meta/Utils/build_vcpkg.py

      - name: Configure (Distribution preset)
        run: |
          LLVM_BIN="$(brew --prefix llvm@${LLVM_VERSION})/bin"
          cmake --preset Distribution -B Build \
            -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER="${LLVM_BIN}/clang" \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="${LLVM_BIN}/clang++"

      - name: Build
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}/Build
        run: cmake --build . --parallel $(sysctl -n hw.logicalcpu)

      - name: Install into staging prefix
        run: cmake --install Build --strip --prefix ${{ github.workspace }}/Install

      - name: Bundle and zip .app
        run: |
          COMMIT_SHORT="${GITHUB_SHA::8}"
          TIMESTAMP="$(date -u +%Y%m%d)"
          VERSION="${TIMESTAMP}-${COMMIT_SHORT}"

          APP_BUNDLE=$(find Install -name "*.app" -maxdepth 5 | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APP_BUNDLE" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: no .app found under Install/:"
            find Install | head -40
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Found bundle: $APP_BUNDLE"

          FRAMEWORKS="$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/Frameworks"
          mkdir -p "$FRAMEWORKS"

          VCPKG_LIB="Build/vcpkg_installed/arm64-osx/lib"
          [ -d "$VCPKG_LIB" ] && cp -n "$VCPKG_LIB"/*.dylib "$FRAMEWORKS/" 2>/dev/null || true

          LOCAL_LIB="Build/lib"
          [ -d "$LOCAL_LIB" ] && cp -Rn "$LOCAL_LIB"/. "$FRAMEWORKS/" 2>/dev/null || true

          for EXE in "$APP_BUNDLE/Contents/MacOS"/*; do
            [ -f "$EXE" ] || continue
            install_name_tool -add_rpath "@executable_path/../Frameworks" "$EXE" 2>/dev/null || true
          done

          ARCHIVE="Ladybird-${VERSION}-macos-arm64.zip"
          cd "$(dirname "$APP_BUNDLE")"
          zip -r --symlinks "${{ github.workspace }}/${ARCHIVE}" "$(basename "$APP_BUNDLE")"
          echo "MACOS_ARCHIVE=${{ github.workspace }}/${ARCHIVE}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Upload macOS artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: macos-app
          path: ${{ env.MACOS_ARCHIVE }}
          retention-days: 7

  # ── Publish Release ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  release:
    name: Publish Release
    needs: [build-linux, build-macos]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    if: always() && (needs.build-linux.result == 'success' || needs.build-macos.result == 'success')

    steps:
      - name: Download Linux AppImage
        if: needs.build-linux.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: linux-appimage
          path: dist/

      - name: Download macOS app
        if: needs.build-macos.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: macos-app
          path: dist/

      - name: Download release tag
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: release-tag
          path: .

      - name: Read release tag
        run: echo "RELEASE_TAG=$(cat release-tag.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: List dist
        run: ls -lh dist/

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}
          name: "Ladybird ${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}"
          body: |
            ## Ladybird Browser — automated build

            **Commit:** [`${{ github.sha }}`](${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/commit/${{ github.sha }})
            **Branch:** `${{ github.ref_name }}`
            **Built at:** ${{ github.event.head_commit.timestamp }}

            ### Assets
            | File | Platform |
            |------|----------|
            | `*.AppImage` | Linux x86-64 — self-contained, no install needed |
            | `*.zip` | macOS arm64 — drag `.app` to `/Applications` |

            ### Linux usage
            ```bash
            chmod +x Ladybird-*.AppImage
            ./Ladybird-*.AppImage
            ```

            ### macOS usage
            Unzip, drag `Ladybird.app` to `/Applications`.
            First launch: right-click → Open to bypass Gatekeeper (unsigned build).

            > ⚠️ Unofficial pre-alpha builds from
            > [collabskus/ladybird](https://github.com/collabskus/ladybird),
            > tracking [LadybirdBrowser/ladybird](https://github.com/LadybirdBrowser/ladybird).
          files: dist/*
          make_latest: true
          fail_on_unmatched_files: false

FILE: .github/workflows/js-and-wasm-artifacts.yml
name: Package the js repl as a binary artifact

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      reference_to_build:
        description: 'Branch, tag or commit hash to build'
        required: true
        type: string

env:
  LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}
  CCACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.ccache

jobs:
  build-and-package:
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(matrix.runner_labels) }}
    if: github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird'
    name: ${{ matrix.os_name }}, ${{ matrix.arch }}
    container: ${{ fromJSON(matrix.container) }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os_name: ['Linux']
        arch: ['x86_64']
        toolchain: ['Clang']
        package_type: ['Linux-x86_64']
        runner_labels: ['["blacksmith-8vcpu-ubuntu-2404"]']
        container: [&ci_container '{"image":"ghcr.io/ladybirdbrowser/ladybird-ci:2026.11.21"}']

        include:
          - os_name: 'macOS'
            arch: 'arm64'
            toolchain: 'Clang'
            package_type: 'macOS-arm64'
            runner_labels: '["blacksmith-6vcpu-macos-26"]'
            container: 'null'

          - os_name: 'Linux'
            arch: 'arm64'
            toolchain: 'Clang'
            package_type: 'Linux-aarch64'
            runner_labels: '["blacksmith-8vcpu-ubuntu-2404-arm"]'
            container: *ci_container

    steps:
      - name: Checkout LadybirdBrowser/ladybird
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.reference_to_build }}

      - name: 'Determine build commit hash'
        id: build-commit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: "Set up environment"
        id: 'setup'
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup
        with:
          os: ${{ matrix.os_name }}
          arch: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          build_preset: 'Distribution'

      - name: Restore Caches
        uses: $/.github/actions/cache-restore
        id: 'cache-restore'
        with:
          os: ${{ matrix.os_name }}
          arch: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
          cache_key_extra: 'LibJS and LibWasm Artifacts'
          ccache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.ccache_path }}
          sccache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.sccache_path }}
          vcpkg_cache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.vcpkg_cache_path }}

      - name: Create build directory Ubuntu
        run: |
          cmake --preset Distribution \
            -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ \
            -DENABLE_GUI_TARGETS=OFF
        if: ${{ matrix.os_name == 'Linux' }}

      # FIXME: Add the following flag back when vcpkg supports Universal binaries:
      #        -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES="x86_64;arm64"
      #
      #        See: https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg/discussions/19454
      - name: Create build directory macOS
        run: |
          cmake --preset Distribution \
            -DCMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET="12.0" \
            -DENABLE_GUI_TARGETS=OFF
        if: ${{ matrix.os_name == 'macOS' }}

      - name: Build js
        working-directory: Build/distribution
        run: |
          ninja js

      - name: Build wasm
        working-directory: Build/distribution
        run: |
          ninja wasm

      - name: Package js and wasm
        working-directory: Build/distribution
        run: |
          cpack

          # Inject the COMMIT file for older builds (before commit 5c5de0e30e04).
          for package in ladybird-*.tar.gz; do
            if ! tar -tzf "${package}" | grep -qx COMMIT; then
              echo "${{ steps.build-commit.outputs.sha }}" > COMMIT
              gunzip "${package}"
              tar --append --file="${package%.gz}" COMMIT
              gzip "${package%.gz}"
              rm COMMIT
            fi
          done

      - name: Save Caches
        uses: $/.github/actions/cache-save
        with:
          arch: 'Lagom'
          ccache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.ccache_path }}
          ccache_primary_key: ${{ steps.cache-restore.outputs.ccache_primary_key }}
          sccache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.sccache_path }}
          sccache_primary_key: ${{ steps.cache-restore.outputs.sccache_primary_key }}
          vcpkg_cache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.vcpkg_cache_path }}
          vcpkg_cache_primary_key: ${{ steps.cache-restore.outputs.vcpkg_cache_primary_key }}

      - name: Sanity-check the js repl
        shell: bash
        run: |
          path="Build/distribution/ladybird-js-${{ matrix.package_type }}.tar.gz"
          if [ -f "${path}" ]; then
            tar -xvzf "${path}"
            bin/js -c "console.log('Hello, World\!');" > js-repl-out.txt
            if ! grep -q "\"Hello, World\!\"" js-repl-out.txt; then
              echo "Sanity check failed: \"Hello, World\!\" not found in output."
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Sanity-check the wasm repl
        shell: bash
        run: |
          path="Build/distribution/ladybird-wasm-${{ matrix.package_type }}.tar.gz"
          if [ -f "${path}" ]; then
            tar -xvzf "${path}"
            bin/wasm -e run_sanity_check -w "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/Libraries/LibWasm/Tests/CI/ci-sanity-check.wasm" > wasm-repl-out.txt
            if ! grep -q "Hello, World\!" wasm-repl-out.txt; then
              echo "Sanity check failed: Hello, World\! not found in output."
              exit 1
            fi
          fi

      - name: Upload js package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          name: ladybird-js-${{ matrix.package_type }}
          path: Build/distribution/ladybird-js-*.tar.gz
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload wasm package
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          name: ladybird-wasm-${{ matrix.package_type }}
          path: Build/distribution/ladybird-wasm-*.tar.gz
          retention-days: 7

FILE: .github/workflows/js-and-wasm-benchmarks.yml
name: 'JS benchmarks'

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['Package the js repl as a binary artifact']
    branches: [master]
    types: [completed]

jobs:
  js-benchmarks:
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(matrix.runner_labels) }}
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird' && github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    name: ${{ matrix.os_name }}, ${{ matrix.arch }}
    container: ${{ fromJSON(matrix.container) }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os_name: ['Linux']
        arch: ['x86_64']
        package_type: ['Linux-x86_64']
        runner_labels: ['["ubuntu-24.04-internal", "js-benchmarks", "self-hosted"]']
        container: ['{"image":"ghcr.io/ladybirdbrowser/ladybird-ci:2026.11.21"}']

        include:
          - os_name: 'macOS'
            arch: 'arm64'
            package_type: 'macOS-arm64'
            runner_labels: '["macos-26", "js-benchmarks", "self-hosted"]'
            container: 'null'

    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: 'Checkout LadybirdBrowser/js-benchmarks'
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: LadybirdBrowser/js-benchmarks
          path: js-benchmarks
          ref: master

      - name: 'Determine js-benchmarks commit hash'
        id: js-benchmarks-commit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd js-benchmarks
          echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: 'Download JS repl artifact'
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v28
        with:
          run_id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          name: ladybird-js-${{ matrix.package_type }}
          path: js-repl

      - name: 'Extract JS repl'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd js-repl
          tar -xvzf ladybird-js-${{ matrix.os_name }}-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz

      - name: 'Determine JS repl build commit hash'
        id: js-build-commit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          commit_hash=$(cat js-repl/COMMIT)
          echo "sha=${commit_hash}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: 'Download wasm repl artifact'
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v28
        with:
          run_id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          name: ladybird-wasm-${{ matrix.package_type }}
          path: wasm-repl
          if_no_artifact_found: warn

      - name: 'Extract wasm repl'
        if: ${{ hashFiles('wasm-repl/*.tar.gz') != '' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd wasm-repl
          tar -xvzf ladybird-wasm-${{ matrix.os_name }}-${{ matrix.arch }}.tar.gz

      - name: 'Run the benchmarks'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cd js-benchmarks
          python3 -m venv .venv
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt

          run_options='--iterations=3'

          js_path="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/js-repl/bin/js"
          run_options="${run_options} --executable=${js_path}"

          wasm_path="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/wasm-repl/bin/wasm"
          if [ -x "${wasm_path}" ]; then
              run_options="${run_options} --wasm-executable=${wasm_path}"
          else
              echo "Wasm repl not found; skipping wasm benchmarks."
          fi

          if [ "${{ github.event.workflow_run.event }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
              # Upstream was run manually; we might run into failing benchmarks as a result of older builds.
              run_options="${run_options} --continue-on-failure"
          fi

          ./run.py ${run_options}

      - name: 'Save results as an artifact'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7.0.2
        with:
          name: js-benchmarks-results-${{ matrix.os_name }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: js-benchmarks/results.json
          retention-days: 90

      - name: 'Call webhook'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo '{
              "commit": "${{ steps.js-build-commit.outputs.sha }}",
              "benchmarks_commit": "${{ steps.js-benchmarks-commit.outputs.sha }}",
              "os": "${{ matrix.os_name }}",
              "arch": "${{ matrix.arch }}",
              "artifact": "js-benchmarks-results-${{ matrix.os_name }}-${{ matrix.arch }}",
              "artifact_run_id": "${{ github.run_id }}"
          }' > request.json
          curl \
              --fail \
              --silent \
              --show-error \
              --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
              --header "X-Hub-Signature-256: sha256=$(openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac '${{ secrets.JS_BENCHMARKS_WEBHOOK_SECRET }}' request.json | cut -d' ' -f2)" \
              --data-binary '@request.json' \
              '${{ secrets.JS_BENCHMARKS_WEBHOOK_URL }}'

FILE: .github/workflows/libjs-test262.yml
name: Run test262 and test-wasm

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || format('{0}-{1}', github.ref, github.run_number) }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}
  CCACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.ccache

jobs:
  run_and_update_results:
    runs-on: 'blacksmith-16vcpu-ubuntu-2404'
    if: github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird'
    # Master runs check out libjs-data when they start and force-push it with their results appended, so they must not
    # overlap, or the run that pushes second drops the other's entry. Pull request runs never push, so they don't wait.
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' && 'libjs-test262-master' || format('libjs-test262-{0}', github.run_id) }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/ladybirdbrowser/ladybird-ci:2026.11.21

    steps:
      - name: Checkout LadybirdBrowser/ladybird
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout LadybirdBrowser/libjs-test262
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: LadybirdBrowser/libjs-test262
          path: libjs-test262

      - name: Checkout LadybirdBrowser/libjs-data
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: LadybirdBrowser/libjs-data
          path: libjs-data

      - name: Checkout tc39/test262
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: tc39/test262
          path: test262

      - name: Checkout tc39/test262-parser-tests
        uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: tc39/test262-parser-tests
          path: test262-parser-tests

      - name: Set up environment
        id: 'setup'
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup
        with:
          os: 'Linux'
          arch: 'x86_64'
          toolchain: 'Clang'
          build_preset: 'Release'

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r libjs-test262/requirements.txt

      - name: Restore Caches
        uses: $/.github/actions/cache-restore
        id: 'cache-restore'
        with:
          os: 'Linux'
          arch: 'x86_64'
          toolchain: 'Clang'
          cache_key_extra: 'test262'
          ccache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.ccache_path }}
          sccache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.sccache_path }}
          vcpkg_cache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.vcpkg_cache_path }}

      - name: Get previous results
        run: |
          mkdir -p old-libjs-data
          cp -R libjs-data/test262 libjs-data/wasm old-libjs-data

      - name: Warm up the Rust toolchain
        run: rustup toolchain install

      - name: Build test262-runner, test-js, and test-wasm
        run: |
          cmake --preset Release -B libjs-test262/Build \
            -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ \
            -DLADYBIRD_BASELINE_CPU_TARGET=ON \
            -DWASM_SPEC_TEST_SKIP_FORMATTING=ON \
            -DINCLUDE_WASM_SPEC_TESTS=ON \
            -DENABLE_GUI_TARGETS=OFF
          ninja -C libjs-test262/Build test262-runner test-js test-wasm

      - name: Save Caches
        uses: $/.github/actions/cache-save
        with:
          arch: 'x86_64'
          ccache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.ccache_path }}
          ccache_primary_key: ${{ steps.cache-restore.outputs.ccache_primary_key }}
          sccache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.sccache_path }}
          sccache_primary_key: ${{ steps.cache-restore.outputs.sccache_primary_key }}
          vcpkg_cache_path: ${{ steps.setup.outputs.vcpkg_cache_path }}
          vcpkg_cache_primary_key: ${{ steps.cache-restore.outputs.vcpkg_cache_primary_key }}

      - name: Run test262 and test262-parser-tests
        working-directory: libjs-test262
        run: |
          python3 run_all_and_update_results.py \
            --serenity .. \
            --test262 ../test262 \
            --test262-parser-tests ../test262-parser-tests \
            --results-json ../libjs-data/test262/results.json \
            --per-file-output ../libjs-data/test262/per-file-master.json

      - name: Run test-wasm
        working-directory: libjs-test262
        run: |
          Build/bin/test-wasm --per-file Build/Libraries/LibWasm/Tests > ../libjs-data/wasm/per-file-master.json || true
          jq -nc -f /dev/stdin <<-EOF --slurpfile previous ../libjs-data/wasm/results.json --slurpfile details ../libjs-data/wasm/per-file-master.json > wasm-new-results.json
            \$details[0] as \$details | \$previous[0] + [{
              "commit_timestamp": $(git -C .. log -1 --format=%ct),
              "run_timestamp": $(date +%s),
              "versions": {
                "serenity": "$(git -C .. rev-parse HEAD)"
              },
              "tests": {
                "spectest": {
                  "duration": (\$details.duration),
                  "results": {
                    "total": (\$details.results | keys | length),
                    "passed": ([\$details.results | values[] | select(. == "PASSED")] | length),
                    "failed": ([\$details.results | values[] | select(. == "FAILED")] | length),
                    "skipped": ([\$details.results | values[] | select(. == "SKIPPED")] | length),
                    "process_error": ([\$details.results | values[] | select(. == "PROCESS_ERROR")] | length)
                  }
                }
              }
            }]
          EOF
          mv wasm-new-results.json ../libjs-data/wasm/results.json

      - name: Compare test262 results
        run: ./libjs-test262/per_file_result_diff.py -o old-libjs-data/test262/per-file-master.json -n libjs-data/test262/per-file-master.json

      - name: Compare Wasm results
        run: ./libjs-test262/per_file_result_diff.py -o old-libjs-data/wasm/per-file-master.json -n libjs-data/wasm/per-file-master.json

      - name: Create libjs-data token
        id: libjs-data-token
        if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' }}
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@v3.4.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.LIBJS_DATA_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.LIBJS_DATA_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: LadybirdBrowser
          repositories: libjs-data
          permission-contents: write

      - name: Deploy to GitHub
        if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' }}
        uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4.9.0
        with:
          git-config-name: LadybirdBot
          git-config-email: ladybirdbot@ladybird.org
          branch: master
          repository-name: LadybirdBrowser/libjs-data
          token: ${{ steps.libjs-data-token.outputs.token }}
          folder: libjs-data

FILE: .github/workflows/lint-code.yml
name: Lint Code

on:
  push:
    branches: [master, 'release/*']
  pull_request:

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404
    if: github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird'
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/ladybirdbrowser/ladybird-ci:2026.11.21

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1

      - name: Set Up Environment
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup
        with:
          os: 'Linux'
          arch: 'x86_64'
          type: 'lint'

      - name: Install the toolchain of the Rust GC lints
        working-directory: Meta/RustLints
        run: rustup toolchain install

      - name: Lint
        run: "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/Meta/lint-ci.sh"

  lockfile:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404
    if: github.repository == 'LadybirdBrowser/ladybird'

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify the actions lockfile
        uses: github/gh-actions-lock@verify/v0.5.1

    permissions:

    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404

      image: ghcr.io/ladybirdbrowser/ladybird-ci:2026.11.21

        with:
          os: 'Linux'
          arch: 'x86_64'
          type: 'lint'

      - name: Check Flap
        run: |
          cargo fmt --manifest-path Libraries/LibJS/Flap/Cargo.toml -- --check
          cargo clippy --manifest-path Libraries/LibJS/Flap/Cargo.toml \
            --all-targets -- -D clippy::all

      - name: Generate and assemble the Flap interpreter
        run: |
          cargo build --release --manifest-path Libraries/LibJS/Flap/Cargo.toml
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/flap-smoke"
          for arch in x86_64 aarch64; do
            Libraries/LibJS/Flap/target/release/flapc \
              --arch "${arch}" \
              --object-format elf \
              --constants Libraries/LibJS/Flap/tests/interpreter-layout.conf \
              --input Libraries/LibJS/Interpreter/interpreter.flap \
              --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/flap-smoke/${arch}.S"
            clang --target="${arch}-unknown-linux-gnu" \
              -c "${RUNNER_TEMP}/flap-smoke/${arch}.S" \
              -o "${RUNNER_TEMP}/flap-smoke/${arch}.o"
            Libraries/LibJS/Flap/target/release/flapc \
              --arch "${arch}" \
              --object-format elf \
              --constants Libraries/LibJS/Flap/tests/interpreter-layout.conf \
              --input Libraries/LibJS/Interpreter/interpreter.flap \
              --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/flap-smoke/${arch}-repeat.S"
            cmp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/flap-smoke/${arch}.S" \
              "${RUNNER_TEMP}/flap-smoke/${arch}-repeat.S"
          done
