    if (auto const* array = type->getAsArrayTypeUnsafe())
        return type_holds_gc_pointer(array->getElementType(), visited);

    if (type->isPointerType() || type->isReferenceType()) {
        auto const* pointee = type->getPointeeCXXRecordDecl();
        auto const* definition = pointee ? pointee->getDefinition() : nullptr;
        return definition && record_inherits_from_cell(*definition);
    }

    if (auto instance = template_instance_of_type(type)) {
        if (instance->name == "GC::Ptr" || instance->name == "GC::Ref")
            return true;
        if (is_type_that_does_not_store_gc_pointers_by_value(instance->name))
            return false;
        for (auto const& type_argument : instance->type_arguments) {
            if (type_holds_gc_pointer(type_argument, visited))
                return true;
        }
    }

    auto const* record = type->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
    if (!record || !record->isCompleteDefinition() || !visited.insert(record).second)
        return false;
    if (record_is_nan_boxed_value(*record))
        return true;
    if (record_is_in_ak_or_gc(*record) || record_inherits_from_cell(*record))
        return false;
    for (auto const& base : record->bases()) {
        if (type_holds_gc_pointer(base.getType(), visited))
            return true;
    }
    for (auto const* field : record->fields()) {
        if (type_holds_gc_pointer(field->getType(), visited))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// Whether a type declares with GC_HOLDS_NO_CELL_EDGES, or inherits from one that declares, that it holds no cell edges.
static bool record_declares_no_cell_edges(clang::CXXRecordDecl const& record)
{
    auto declares = [](clang::CXXRecordDecl const* candidate) {
        for (auto const* declaration : candidate->decls()) {
            if (auto const* alias = llvm::dyn_cast<clang::TypedefNameDecl>(declaration); alias && alias->getName() == "HoldsNoCellEdges")
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    };
    if (declares(&record))
        return true;
    // NB: forallBases() gives up on a dependent base, so the bases are walked here, skipping those not known yet.
    for (auto const& base : record.bases()) {
        auto const* base_record = base.getType()->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
        base_record = base_record ? base_record->getDefinition() : nullptr;
        if (base_record && record_declares_no_cell_edges(*base_record))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

enum class ClaimViolation {
    GCPointer,
    OpaqueFunction,
};

static bool is_owning_pointer(std::string const& template_name)
{
    return template_name == "AK::NonnullOwnPtr" || template_name == "AK::NonnullRefPtr" || template_name == "AK::OwnPtr" || template_name == "AK::RefPtr";
}

// Whether a value of this type holds what a type declared to hold no cell edges must not: a GC pointer, which nothing
// would trace, or an AK::Function, whose captures no check can see. Roots and weak pointers need no tracing. A GC pointer
// is looked for in what the value owns too, unless the pointee declares the claim itself and is checked on its own.
// NB: An owned object's callbacks are its own API, such as those of libraries below LibGC, which can't keep a
//     GC::Function. As with every AK::Function, what they capture must be rooted or weak.
static bool record_violates_claim_of_no_cell_edges(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&, ClaimViolation, std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*>& visited, PolymorphicSubclasses const&);

static bool type_violates_claim_of_no_cell_edges(clang::QualType type, ClaimViolation violation, std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*>& visited, PolymorphicSubclasses const& polymorphic_subclasses)
{
    if (auto const* array = type->getAsArrayTypeUnsafe())
        return type_violates_claim_of_no_cell_edges(array->getElementType(), violation, visited, polymorphic_subclasses);

    // NB: A raw pointer to a cell, or to something with cell edges such as the mixin of a cell, is an edge that nothing
    //     traces. Whether a pointee that is only declared is one can't be seen.
    if (type->isPointerType() || type->isReferenceType()) {
        if (violation != ClaimViolation::GCPointer)
            return false;
        auto const* pointee = type->getPointeeCXXRecordDecl();
        auto const* definition = pointee ? pointee->getDefinition() : nullptr;
        return definition && (record_inherits_from_cell(*definition) || (!record_is_in_ak_or_gc(*definition) && type_has_visit_edges_method(definition)));
    }

    if (auto instance = template_instance_of_type(type)) {
        if (instance->name == "AK::Function")
            return violation == ClaimViolation::OpaqueFunction;
        if (instance->name == "GC::Ptr" || instance->name == "GC::Ref" || instance->name == "GC::Member" || instance->name == "GC::NonnullMember")
            return violation == ClaimViolation::GCPointer;
        if (is_owning_pointer(instance->name)) {
            if (violation != ClaimViolation::GCPointer || instance->type_arguments.empty())
                return false;
            auto const* pointee = instance->type_arguments.front()->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
            pointee = pointee ? pointee->getDefinition() : nullptr;
            if (pointee && record_declares_no_cell_edges(*pointee))
                return false;
            if (type_violates_claim_of_no_cell_edges(instance->type_arguments.front(), violation, visited, polymorphic_subclasses))
                return true;
            // NB: The pointer may own a subclass of its pointee.
            if (!pointee)
                return false;
            auto subclasses = polymorphic_subclasses.find(pointee->getCanonicalDecl());
            if (subclasses == polymorphic_subclasses.end())
                return false;
            for (auto const* subclass : subclasses->second) {
                if (record_declares_no_cell_edges(*subclass))
                    continue;
                if (record_violates_claim_of_no_cell_edges(*subclass, violation, visited, polymorphic_subclasses))
                    return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        if (is_type_that_does_not_store_gc_pointers_by_value(instance->name))
            return false;
        for (auto const& type_argument : instance->type_arguments) {
            if (type_violates_claim_of_no_cell_edges(type_argument, violation, visited, polymorphic_subclasses))
                return true;
        }
    }

    auto const* record = type->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
    return record && record_violates_claim_of_no_cell_edges(*record, violation, visited, polymorphic_subclasses);
}

static bool record_violates_claim_of_no_cell_edges(clang::CXXRecordDecl const& record, ClaimViolation violation, std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*>& visited, PolymorphicSubclasses const& polymorphic_subclasses)
{
    if (!record.isCompleteDefinition() || !visited.insert(&record).second)
        return false;
    if (record_is_nan_boxed_value(record))
        return violation == ClaimViolation::GCPointer;
    if (record_is_in_ak_or_gc(record) || record_inherits_from_cell(record))
        return false;
    for (auto const& base : record.bases()) {
        if (type_violates_claim_of_no_cell_edges(base.getType(), violation, visited, polymorphic_subclasses))
            return true;
    }
    for (auto const* field : record.fields()) {
        if (type_violates_claim_of_no_cell_edges(field->getType(), violation, visited, polymorphic_subclasses))
            return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// A GC::Function captures a type that declares that it holds no cell edges without tracing it, so the type must not hold
// a GC pointer, which nothing would keep alive. Roots and weak pointers are fine, as they need no tracing. Nor may it hold
// an AK::Function, whose captures could hold anything.
// NB: Claims are checked once the translation unit is complete, when every instantiation of a class template that makes
//     the claim, and every subclass of what a claimed type owns, is known.
void LibJSGCVisitor::remember_claim_of_no_cell_edges(clang::CXXRecordDecl const& record)
{
    clang::CXXRecordDecl const* claimed_record = nullptr;
    bool callbacks_hold_roots = false;
    bool claim_covers_subclasses = false;
    if (auto const* specialization = llvm::dyn_cast<clang::ClassTemplateSpecializationDecl>(&record)) {
        if (specialization->getSpecializationKind() != clang::TSK_ExplicitSpecialization || specialization->getSpecializedTemplate()->getQualifiedNameAsString() != "GC::IsUntracedCapture")
            return;
        // NB: GC_UNTRACED_CAPTURE_WITH_ROOTED_CALLBACKS() declares that the type's callbacks hold roots, which no check
        //     can see, so only its other members are checked.
        for (auto const* declaration : specialization->decls()) {
            if (auto const* variable = llvm::dyn_cast<clang::VarDecl>(declaration); variable && variable->getName() == "callbacks_hold_roots")
                callbacks_hold_roots = true;
        }
        // NB: A partial specialization declares the claim for whatever its arguments hold, which is checked where they
        //     make claims of their own.
        auto const& arguments = specialization->getTemplateArgs();
        if (llvm::isa<clang::ClassTemplatePartialSpecializationDecl>(specialization) || arguments.size() != 1 || arguments[0].getKind() != clang::TemplateArgument::Type || arguments[0].getAsType()->isDependentType())
            return;
        claimed_record = arguments[0].getAsType()->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
        // NB: Unlike a claim made in the class, which its subclasses inherit and make themselves, this one covers a
        //     counted or owned pointer to the class, which may point to a subclass.
        claim_covers_subclasses = true;
    } else if (record_declares_no_cell_edges(record)) {
        claimed_record = &record;
    }
    if (claimed_record)
        m_claims_of_no_cell_edges.push_back({ claimed_record, callbacks_hold_roots, claim_covers_subclasses });
}

void LibJSGCVisitor::validate_claims_of_no_cell_edges()
{
    std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*> validated;
    auto validate = [&](clang::CXXRecordDecl const* record, bool callbacks_hold_roots, clang::CXXRecordDecl const* claiming_base = nullptr) {
        if (record && record->isCompleteDefinition() && !record->isDependentContext() && validated.insert(record).second)
            validate_claim_of_no_cell_edges(*record, callbacks_hold_roots, claiming_base);
    };
    for (auto const& claim : m_claims_of_no_cell_edges) {
        if (auto const* class_template = claim.record->getDescribedClassTemplate()) {
            for (auto const* specialization : class_template->specializations())
                validate(specialization, claim.callbacks_hold_roots);
            continue;
        }
        auto const* definition = claim.record->getDefinition();
        validate(definition, claim.callbacks_hold_roots);
        if (!claim.covers_subclasses || !definition)
            continue;
        // NB: A subclass that makes the claim itself is checked on its own.
        auto subclasses = m_polymorphic_subclasses.find(definition->getCanonicalDecl());
        if (subclasses == m_polymorphic_subclasses.end())
            continue;
        for (auto const* subclass : subclasses->second) {
            if (!record_declares_no_cell_edges(*subclass))
                validate(subclass, claim.callbacks_hold_roots, definition);
        }
    }
}

// NB: A subclass of a class whose counted or owned pointers are declared to hold no cell edges is checked with the claiming
//     base, which is checked on its own.
void LibJSGCVisitor::validate_claim_of_no_cell_edges(clang::CXXRecordDecl const& record, bool callbacks_hold_roots, clang::CXXRecordDecl const* claiming_base)
{
    auto const* claimed_record = &record;
    auto& diag_engine = m_context.getDiagnostics();
    auto diag_id = diag_engine.getCustomDiagID(clang::DiagnosticsEngine::Error, "%0 is declared to hold no cell edges, but its member %1 holds a GC pointer");
    auto record_name = name_for_diagnostic(m_context, *claimed_record);
    if (claiming_base)
        record_name += " (through its base " + name_for_diagnostic(m_context, *claiming_base) + ")";
    auto function_diag_id = diag_engine.getCustomDiagID(clang::DiagnosticsEngine::Error, "%0 is declared to hold no cell edges, but its member %1 holds an AK::Function, whose captures can't be checked");
    auto violates = [&](clang::QualType type, ClaimViolation violation) {
        if (violation == ClaimViolation::OpaqueFunction && callbacks_hold_roots)
            return false;
        // NB: The claimed type is checked here already, wherever its members lead back to it, such as through the
        //     template arguments of RefCounted<T>.
        std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*> visited { claimed_record };
        if (claiming_base)
            visited.insert(claiming_base);
        return type_violates_claim_of_no_cell_edges(type, violation, visited, m_polymorphic_subclasses);
    };
    for (auto const* field : claimed_record->fields()) {
        if (violates(field->getType(), ClaimViolation::GCPointer))
            diag_engine.Report(field->getLocation(), diag_id) << record_name << field->getName();
        if (violates(field->getType(), ClaimViolation::OpaqueFunction))
            diag_engine.Report(field->getLocation(), function_diag_id) << record_name << field->getName();
    }

    // NB: A base that declares the claim itself is checked on its own.
    auto base_diag_id = diag_engine.getCustomDiagID(clang::DiagnosticsEngine::Error, "%0 is declared to hold no cell edges, but its base %1 holds a GC pointer");
    auto base_function_diag_id = diag_engine.getCustomDiagID(clang::DiagnosticsEngine::Error, "%0 is declared to hold no cell edges, but its base %1 holds an AK::Function, whose captures can't be checked");
    for (auto const& base : claimed_record->bases()) {
        auto const* base_record = base.getType()->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
        if (base_record && record_declares_no_cell_edges(*base_record))
            continue;
        if (violates(base.getType(), ClaimViolation::GCPointer))
            diag_engine.Report(base.getBeginLoc(), base_diag_id) << record_name << base.getType();
        if (violates(base.getType(), ClaimViolation::OpaqueFunction))
            diag_engine.Report(base.getBeginLoc(), base_function_diag_id) << record_name << base.getType();
    }
}

void LibJSGCVisitor::validate_gc_members_of_polymorphic_record(clang::CXXRecordDecl const& record)
{
    if (record.isDependentContext() || !record.isPolymorphic() || type_has_visit_edges_method(&record))
        return;

    bool has_polymorphic_base = false;
    record.forallBases([&](clang::CXXRecordDecl const* base) {
        has_polymorphic_base |= base->isPolymorphic();
        return !has_polymorphic_base;
    });
    if (!has_polymorphic_base)
        return;

    auto& diag_engine = m_context.getDiagnostics();
    auto diag_id = diag_engine.getCustomDiagID(clang::DiagnosticsEngine::Error, "Member %0 of polymorphic class %1 contains GC pointers but %1 has no visit_edges method");
    auto record_name = name_for_diagnostic(m_context, record);
    for (auto const* field : record.fields()) {
        std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*> visited;
        if (type_holds_gc_pointer(field->getType(), visited))
            diag_engine.Report(field->getLocation(), diag_id) << field->getName() << record_name;
    }
}

void LibJSGCVisitor::remember_polymorphic_subclass(clang::CXXRecordDecl const& record)
{
    if (record.isDependentContext() || !record.isPolymorphic())
        return;
    record.forallBases([&](clang::CXXRecordDecl const* base) {
        if (base->isPolymorphic())
            m_polymorphic_subclasses[base->getCanonicalDecl()].push_back(&record);
        return true;
    });
}

static bool is_container_with_heap_storage(std::string const& template_name)
{
    static std::unordered_set<std::string> const template_names {
        "AK::DoublyLinkedList",
        "AK::FixedArray",
        "AK::HashMap",
        "AK::HashTable",
        "AK::Queue",
        "AK::SinglyLinkedList",
        "AK::Vector",
    };
    return template_names.contains(template_name);
}

// The GC sees the values these store, but not the heap storage of a container stored in one of them.
static bool is_container_scanned_by_gc(std::string const& template_name)
{
    static std::unordered_set<std::string> const template_names {
        "GC::RootHashMap",
        "GC::RootHashTable",
        "GC::RootVector",
    };
    return template_names.contains(template_name);
}

static bool is_root_container(std::string const& template_name)
{
    return template_name == "GC::RootHashMap" || template_name == "GC::RootHashTable" || template_name == "GC::RootVector";
}

static bool is_value_wrapper(std::string const& template_name)
{
    static std::unordered_set<std::string> const template_names {
        "AK::Array",
        "AK::ErrorOr",
        "AK::Optional",
        "AK::Tuple",
        "AK::Variant",
    };
    return template_names.contains(template_name);
}

static std::optional<clang::QualType> find_container_with_unscanned_gc_pointers(clang::QualType, std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*>& visited, PolymorphicSubclasses const* subclasses_of_owned_types = nullptr);

static clang::FieldDecl const* find_owned_member_with_gc_pointers(clang::QualType owned_type, std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*>& visited, PolymorphicSubclasses const& subclasses_of_owned_types)
{
    auto const* record = owned_type->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
    if (!record || !record->getDefinition())
        return nullptr;
    record = record->getDefinition();
    if (record_is_in_ak_or_gc(*record) || record_inherits_from_cell(*record) || !visited.insert(record).second)
        return nullptr;

    std::vector<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*> records { record };
    record->forallBases([&](clang::CXXRecordDecl const* base) {
        records.push_back(base);
        return true;
    });
    if (auto subclasses = subclasses_of_owned_types.find(record->getCanonicalDecl()); subclasses != subclasses_of_owned_types.end())
        records.insert(records.end(), subclasses->second.begin(), subclasses->second.end());

    for (auto const* candidate : records) {
        for (auto const* field : candidate->fields()) {
            std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*> visited_by_field;
            if (type_holds_gc_pointer(field->getType(), visited_by_field) || find_container_with_unscanned_gc_pointers(field->getType(), visited, &subclasses_of_owned_types))
                return field;
        }
    }
    return nullptr;
}

// Conservative stack scanning sees the values stored in a stack object, but not the heap storage of a container in it.
static std::optional<clang::QualType> find_container_with_unscanned_gc_pointers(clang::QualType type, std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*>& visited, PolymorphicSubclasses const* subclasses_of_owned_types)
{
    if (auto const* array = type->getAsArrayTypeUnsafe())
        return find_container_with_unscanned_gc_pointers(array->getElementType(), visited, subclasses_of_owned_types);

    if (type->isPointerType() || type->isReferenceType())
        return {};

    if (auto instance = template_instance_of_type(type)) {
        if (is_container_with_heap_storage(instance->name)) {
            for (auto const& type_argument : instance->type_arguments) {
                std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*> visited_by_element;
                if (type_holds_gc_pointer(type_argument, visited_by_element))
                    return type;
                if (subclasses_of_owned_types && find_container_with_unscanned_gc_pointers(type_argument, visited, subclasses_of_owned_types))
                    return type;
            }
            return {};
        }
        if (subclasses_of_owned_types && is_owning_pointer(instance->name)) {
            for (auto const& type_argument : instance->type_arguments) {
                std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*> visited_by_object;
                if (type_holds_gc_pointer(type_argument, visited_by_object) || find_owned_member_with_gc_pointers(type_argument, visited, *subclasses_of_owned_types))
                    return type;
                if (find_container_with_unscanned_gc_pointers(type_argument, visited, subclasses_of_owned_types))
                    return type;
            }
            return {};
        }
        if (is_value_wrapper(instance->name) || is_container_scanned_by_gc(instance->name)) {
            for (auto const& type_argument : instance->type_arguments) {
                // NB: A root container traces a value with a visit_edges(), which visits what the value keeps on the heap.
                if (is_root_container(instance->name) && type_has_visit_edges_method(type_argument->getAsCXXRecordDecl()))
                    continue;
                if (auto container = find_container_with_unscanned_gc_pointers(type_argument, visited, subclasses_of_owned_types))
                    return container;
            }
            return {};
        }
        if (is_type_that_does_not_store_gc_pointers_by_value(instance->name))
            return {};
    }

    auto const* record = type->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
    if (!record || !record->isCompleteDefinition() || !visited.insert(record).second)
        return {};
    if (record_is_in_ak_or_gc(*record) || record_inherits_from_cell(*record))
        return {};
    for (auto const& base : record->bases()) {
        if (auto container = find_container_with_unscanned_gc_pointers(base.getType(), visited, subclasses_of_owned_types))
            return container;
    }
    for (auto const* field : record->fields()) {
        if (auto container = find_container_with_unscanned_gc_pointers(field->getType(), visited, subclasses_of_owned_types))
            return container;
    }
    return {};
}

static clang::QualType type_of_object_on_stack(clang::VarDecl const& variable)
{
    if (!variable.getType()->isReferenceType())
        return variable.getType();

    // A reference that extends the lifetime of a temporary keeps that temporary on the stack.
    auto const* initializer = variable.getInit();
    if (auto const* expression_with_cleanups = llvm::dyn_cast_or_null<clang::ExprWithCleanups>(initializer))
        initializer = expression_with_cleanups->getSubExpr();
    auto const* temporary = llvm::dyn_cast_or_null<clang::MaterializeTemporaryExpr>(initializer);
    if (!temporary || temporary->getExtendingDecl() != &variable)
        return {};
    return temporary->getType();
}

void LibJSGCVisitor::validate_object_on_stack(clang::VarDecl const& variable, clang::SourceLocation location)
{
    auto type = type_of_object_on_stack(variable);
    if (type.isNull())
        return;

    validate_type_on_stack(type, location);
}

void LibJSGCVisitor::validate_type_on_stack(clang::QualType type, clang::SourceLocation location)
{
    std::set<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*> visited;
    auto container = find_container_with_unscanned_gc_pointers(type, visited);
    if (!container)
        return;

    auto& diag_engine = m_context.getDiagnostics();
    auto diag_id = diag_engine.getCustomDiagID(clang::DiagnosticsEngine::Error, "%0 keeps GC pointers in heap memory that is not scanned for roots; use GC::RootVector, GC::RootHashMap or GC::RootHashTable instead");
    diag_engine.Report(location, diag_id) << *container;
}

bool LibJSGCVisitor::VisitVarDecl(clang::VarDecl* variable)
{
    if (!variable->hasLocalStorage() || variable->isImplicit())
        return true;

    // A parameter passed by value is an object on the stack of the definition, like a local. A container that is moved
    // into a field is taken by rvalue reference instead, so that the caller keeps it until then.
    if (llvm::isa<clang::ParmVarDecl>(variable)) {
        auto const* function = llvm::dyn_cast<clang::FunctionDecl>(variable->getDeclContext());
        if (!function || !function->doesThisDeclarationHaveABody() || function->isImplicit())
            return true;
    }

    validate_object_on_stack(*variable, variable->getLocation());
    return true;
}

// The hidden range variable of a range-based for loop keeps a temporary range alive for the whole loop.
bool LibJSGCVisitor::VisitCXXForRangeStmt(clang::CXXForRangeStmt* for_range)
{
    auto const* range_statement = for_range->getRangeStmt();
    if (!range_statement || !range_statement->isSingleDecl())
        return true;
    if (auto const* range_variable = llvm::dyn_cast<clang::VarDecl>(range_statement->getSingleDecl()))
        validate_object_on_stack(*range_variable, for_range->getRangeInit()->getBeginLoc());
    return true;
}

// A container returned by value becomes a temporary or a local of the caller.
bool LibJSGCVisitor::VisitFunctionDecl(clang::FunctionDecl* function)
{
    if (function->doesThisDeclarationHaveABody() && !function->isImplicit() && !function->getReturnType()->isReferenceType())
        validate_type_on_stack(function->getReturnType(), function->getLocation());
    return true;
}

// The call operator of a lambda is only visited through its body.
bool LibJSGCVisitor::VisitLambdaExpr(clang::LambdaExpr* lambda)
{
    auto return_type = lambda->getCallOperator()->getReturnType();
    if (!return_type->isReferenceType())
        validate_type_on_stack(return_type, lambda->getBeginLoc());
    return true;
}

LibJSGCASTConsumer::LibJSGCASTConsumer(clang::CompilerInstance& compiler, bool detect_invalid_function_members)
    : m_compiler(compiler)
    , m_detect_invalid_function_members(detect_invalid_function_members)
{
    auto& preprocessor = compiler.getPreprocessor();
    preprocessor.addPPCallbacks(std::make_unique<LibJSPPCallbacks>(preprocessor, m_macro_map));
}

void LibJSGCASTConsumer::HandleTranslationUnit(clang::ASTContext& context)
{
    LibJSGCVisitor visitor { context, m_macro_map, m_detect_invalid_function_members };
    visitor.TraverseDecl(context.getTranslationUnitDecl());
    visitor.validate_claims_of_no_cell_edges();
}

char const* LibJSCellMacro::type_name(Type type)
{
    switch (type) {
    case Type::GCCell:
        return "GC_CELL";
    case Type::JSObject:
        return "JS_OBJECT";
    case Type::JSEnvironment:
        return "JS_ENVIRONMENT";
    case Type::JSPrototypeObject:
        return "JS_PROTOTYPE_OBJECT";
    case Type::WebWrappable:
        return "WEB_WRAPPABLE";
    default:
        __builtin_unreachable();
    }
}

void LibJSPPCallbacks::LexedFileChanged(clang::FileID curr_fid, LexedFileChangeReason reason, clang::SrcMgr::CharacteristicKind, clang::FileID, clang::SourceLocation)
{
    if (reason == LexedFileChangeReason::EnterFile) {
        m_curr_fid_hash_stack.push_back(curr_fid.getHashValue());
    } else {
        assert(!m_curr_fid_hash_stack.empty());
        m_curr_fid_hash_stack.pop_back();
    }
}

void LibJSPPCallbacks::MacroExpands(clang::Token const& name_token, clang::MacroDefinition const&, clang::SourceRange range, clang::MacroArgs const* args)
{
    if (auto* ident_info = name_token.getIdentifierInfo()) {
        static llvm::StringMap<LibJSCellMacro::Type> libjs_macro_types {
            { "GC_CELL", LibJSCellMacro::Type::GCCell },
            { "GC_CELL_WITH_CUSTOM_CLASS_NAME", LibJSCellMacro::Type::GCCell },
            { "JS_OBJECT", LibJSCellMacro::Type::JSObject },
            { "JS_OBJECT_WITH_CUSTOM_CLASS_NAME", LibJSCellMacro::Type::JSObject },
            { "JS_ENVIRONMENT", LibJSCellMacro::Type::JSEnvironment },
            { "JS_PROTOTYPE_OBJECT", LibJSCellMacro::Type::JSPrototypeObject },
            { "WEB_WRAPPABLE", LibJSCellMacro::Type::WebWrappable },
            { "WEB_NON_IDL_WRAPPABLE", LibJSCellMacro::Type::WebWrappable },
        };

        auto name = ident_info->getName();
        if (auto it = libjs_macro_types.find(name); it != libjs_macro_types.end()) {
            LibJSCellMacro macro { range, it->second, {} };

            for (size_t arg_index = 0; arg_index < args->getNumMacroArguments(); arg_index++) {
                auto const* first_token = args->getUnexpArgument(arg_index);
                auto stringified_token = clang::MacroArgs::StringifyArgument(first_token, m_preprocessor, false, range.getBegin(), range.getEnd());
                // The token includes leading and trailing quotes
                auto len = strlen(stringified_token.getLiteralData());
                std::string arg_text { stringified_token.getLiteralData() + 1, len - 2 };
                macro.args.push_back({ arg_text, first_token->getLocation() });
            }

            assert(!m_curr_fid_hash_stack.empty());
            auto curr_fid_hash = m_curr_fid_hash_stack.back();
            if (m_macro_map.find(curr_fid_hash) == m_macro_map.end())
                m_macro_map[curr_fid_hash] = {};
            m_macro_map[curr_fid_hash].push_back(macro);
        }
    }
}

#pragma once

#include <clang/AST/ASTConsumer.h>
#include <clang/AST/RecursiveASTVisitor.h>
#include <clang/Frontend/FrontendAction.h>

struct LibJSCellMacro {
    enum class Type {
        GCCell,
        JSObject,
        JSEnvironment,
        JSPrototypeObject,
        WebWrappable,
    };

    struct Arg {
        std::string text;
        clang::SourceLocation location;
    };

    clang::SourceRange range;
    Type type;
    std::vector<Arg> args;

    static char const* type_name(Type);
};

using LibJSCellMacroMap = std::unordered_map<unsigned int, std::vector<LibJSCellMacro>>;

using PolymorphicSubclasses = std::unordered_map<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*, std::vector<clang::CXXRecordDecl const*>>;

class LibJSPPCallbacks : public clang::PPCallbacks {
public:
    LibJSPPCallbacks(clang::Preprocessor& preprocessor, LibJSCellMacroMap& macro_map)
        : m_preprocessor(preprocessor)
        , m_macro_map(macro_map)
    {
    }

    virtual void LexedFileChanged(clang::FileID curr_fid, LexedFileChangeReason, clang::SrcMgr::CharacteristicKind, clang::FileID, clang::SourceLocation) override;

    virtual void MacroExpands(clang::Token const& name_token, clang::MacroDefinition const& definition, clang::SourceRange range, clang::MacroArgs const* args) override;

private:
    clang::Preprocessor& m_preprocessor;
    std::vector<unsigned int> m_curr_fid_hash_stack;
    LibJSCellMacroMap& m_macro_map;
};

class LibJSGCVisitor : public clang::RecursiveASTVisitor<LibJSGCVisitor> {
public:
    explicit LibJSGCVisitor(clang::ASTContext& context, LibJSCellMacroMap const& macro_map, bool detect_invalid_function_members)
        : m_context(context)
        , m_macro_map(macro_map)
        , m_detect_invalid_function_members(detect_invalid_function_members)
    {
    }

    bool VisitCXXRecordDecl(clang::CXXRecordDecl*);
    bool VisitCXXMethodDecl(clang::CXXMethodDecl*);
    bool VisitCXXConstructExpr(clang::CXXConstructExpr*);
    bool VisitClassTemplateDecl(clang::ClassTemplateDecl*);

    void validate_claims_of_no_cell_edges();
    bool VisitVarDecl(clang::VarDecl*);
    bool VisitCXXForRangeStmt(clang::CXXForRangeStmt*);
    bool VisitFunctionDecl(clang::FunctionDecl*);
    bool VisitLambdaExpr(clang::LambdaExpr*);

private:
    struct CellMacroExpectation {
        LibJSCellMacro::Type type;
        std::string base_name;
    };

    void validate_record_macros(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);
    void validate_engine_subclass_is_in_libjs(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);
    void validate_gc_members_of_polymorphic_record(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);
    void remember_claim_of_no_cell_edges(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);
    void validate_claim_of_no_cell_edges(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&, bool callbacks_hold_roots, clang::CXXRecordDecl const* claiming_base = nullptr);
    void remember_polymorphic_subclass(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);
    void validate_object_on_stack(clang::VarDecl const&, clang::SourceLocation);
    void validate_type_on_stack(clang::QualType, clang::SourceLocation);
    CellMacroExpectation get_record_cell_macro_expectation(clang::CXXRecordDecl const&);

    clang::ASTContext& m_context;
    LibJSCellMacroMap const& m_macro_map;
    bool m_detect_invalid_function_members;
    PolymorphicSubclasses m_polymorphic_subclasses;

    struct ClaimOfNoCellEdges {
        clang::CXXRecordDecl const* record;
        bool callbacks_hold_roots;
        bool covers_subclasses;
    };
    std::vector<ClaimOfNoCellEdges> m_claims_of_no_cell_edges;
};

class LibJSGCASTConsumer : public clang::ASTConsumer {
public:
    LibJSGCASTConsumer(clang::CompilerInstance&, bool detect_invalid_function_members);

private:
    virtual void HandleTranslationUnit(clang::ASTContext& context) override;

    clang::CompilerInstance& m_compiler;
    LibJSCellMacroMap m_macro_map;
    bool m_detect_invalid_function_members;
};

class LibJSGCPluginAction : public clang::PluginASTAction {
public:
    virtual bool ParseArgs(clang::CompilerInstance const&, std::vector<std::string> const& args) override
    {
        m_detect_invalid_function_members = std::find(args.begin(), args.end(), "detect-invalid-function-members") != args.end();
        return true;
    }

    virtual std::unique_ptr<clang::ASTConsumer> CreateASTConsumer(clang::CompilerInstance& compiler, llvm::StringRef) override
    {
        return std::make_unique<LibJSGCASTConsumer>(compiler, m_detect_invalid_function_members);
    }

    ActionType getActionType() override
    {
        return AddAfterMainAction;
    }

private:
    bool m_detect_invalid_function_members { false };
};

#include "MathFunctionsPluginAction.h"
#include <clang/Basic/SourceManager.h>
#include <clang/Frontend/FrontendPluginRegistry.h>
#include <llvm/ADT/StringSet.h>
#include <optional>

// The math functions that the C library of each platform computes differently.
static llvm::StringSet<> const math_functions = {
    "acos",
    "acosh",
    "asin",
    "asinh",
    "atan",
    "atan2",
    "atanh",
    "cbrt",
    "cos",
    "cosh",
    "exp",
    "exp2",
    "expm1",
    "hypot",
    "log",
    "log10",
    "log1p",
    "log2",
    "pow",
    "sin",
    "sincos",
    "sinh",
    "tan",
    "tanh",
};

static std::optional<llvm::StringRef> math_function_name(clang::FunctionDecl const& function, clang::SourceManager const& source_manager)
{
    if (!function.getDeclName().isIdentifier())
        return {};

    // A function of our own that shares a name with one of the C library is fine.
    if (!function.getBuiltinID() && !source_manager.isInSystemHeader(function.getCanonicalDecl()->getLocation()))
        return {};

    clang::NamespaceDecl const* outermost_namespace = nullptr;
    for (auto const* context = function.getDeclContext(); context; context = context->getParent()) {
        if (auto const* namespace_decl = llvm::dyn_cast<clang::NamespaceDecl>(context))
            outermost_namespace = namespace_decl;
    }
    if (outermost_namespace && outermost_namespace->getName() != "std")
        return {};

    auto name = function.getName();
    name.consume_front("__builtin_");
    if (math_functions.contains(name))
        return name;
    if ((name.ends_with("f") || name.ends_with("l")) && math_functions.contains(name.drop_back()))
        return name.drop_back();
    return {};
}

bool MathFunctionsVisitor::TraverseDecl(clang::Decl* declaration)
{
    if (declaration) {
        auto location = declaration->getLocation();
        if (location.isValid() && m_context.getSourceManager().isInSystemHeader(location))
            return true;
    }
    return RecursiveASTVisitor::TraverseDecl(declaration);
}

bool MathFunctionsVisitor::VisitDeclRefExpr(clang::DeclRefExpr* reference)
{
    auto const* function = llvm::dyn_cast<clang::FunctionDecl>(reference->getDecl());
    if (!function)
        return true;
    auto& source_manager = m_context.getSourceManager();
    auto name = math_function_name(*function, source_manager);
    if (!name)
        return true;

    auto location = source_manager.getFileLoc(reference->getLocation());
    if (source_manager.isInSystemHeader(location))
        return true;

    auto& diag_engine = m_context.getDiagnostics();
    auto diag_id = diag_engine.getCustomDiagID(clang::DiagnosticsEngine::Error, "%0 is computed differently by the C library of each platform. Use AK::%1 from AK/Math.h instead");
    diag_engine.Report(reference->getBeginLoc(), diag_id) << function << *name;
    return true;
}

void MathFunctionsASTConsumer::HandleTranslationUnit(clang::ASTContext& context)
{
    MathFunctionsVisitor visitor(context);
    visitor.TraverseDecl(context.getTranslationUnitDecl());
}

static clang::FrontendPluginRegistry::Add<MathFunctionsPluginAction> X("math_functions", "check that math functions come from AK/Math.h");

# LibMediaCodecs loads these at runtime on Linux, rather than linking them, and the install rules ship them. CMake 3.25.0
# also sets LINUX for Android, which links FFmpeg.
if (LINUX AND NOT ANDROID)
    foreach (library IN ITEMS AVCODEC LIBSWRESAMPLE)
        # pkg-config leaves out the directory of a library in a default one, so the path it was resolved to is used.
        set(LADYBIRD_BUNDLED_${library}_LIBRARY "${${library}_LINK_LIBRARIES}")
        list(FILTER LADYBIRD_BUNDLED_${library}_LIBRARY INCLUDE REGEX "/lib${${library}_LIBRARIES}\\.so$")
        if (NOT LADYBIRD_BUNDLED_${library}_LIBRARY)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "The bundled lib${${library}_LIBRARIES} is not a shared library")
        endif()
        file(REAL_PATH "${LADYBIRD_BUNDLED_${library}_LIBRARY}" library_file)
        # FFmpeg names each library's soname after its major version, which the file's name starts with.
        cmake_path(GET library_file FILENAME library_file_name)
        if (NOT library_file_name MATCHES "^(.+\\.so\\.[0-9]+)")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Cannot tell the soname of the bundled ${library_file_name}")
        endif()
        set(LADYBIRD_BUNDLED_${library}_SONAME "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
        add_library(BundledFFmpeg::${library} SHARED IMPORTED)
        set_target_properties(BundledFFmpeg::${library} PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${library_file}")

        # Without vcpkg, installs do not carry the bundled FFmpeg, so binaries look for it where it was found, as they do
        # for the libraries they link.
        if ("${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
            cmake_path(GET LADYBIRD_BUNDLED_${library}_LIBRARY PARENT_PATH library_directory)
            if (NOT library_directory IN_LIST CMAKE_CXX_IMPLICIT_LINK_DIRECTORIES AND NOT library_directory IN_LIST CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH)
                list(APPEND CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "${library_directory}")
            endif()
        endif()
    endforeach()
endif()

# Compiles a target against the bundled FFmpeg's headers without linking it, for code that calls it through the
# functions LibMediaCodecs loads.
function(ladybird_use_bundled_ffmpeg_headers target)
    foreach (library IN ITEMS AVCODEC AVUTIL LIBSWRESAMPLE)
        target_include_directories(${target} SYSTEM PRIVATE $<TARGET_PROPERTY:PkgConfig::${library},INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES>)
        target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE $<TARGET_PROPERTY:PkgConfig::${library},INTERFACE_COMPILE_OPTIONS>)
    endforeach()
endfunction()

FILE: Meta/CMake/check_skia_confinement.cmake
# Only the Compositor process links Skia. ladybird_check_skia_confinement() walks the link dependencies of the given
# targets, through the shared libraries that they load and the static libraries that they take in, and fails the
# configuration if any of them reaches Skia.

function(_ladybird_skia_link_path target chain output)
    get_property(visited GLOBAL PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_SKIA_CHECK_VISITED)
    if ("${target}" IN_LIST visited)
        return()
    endif()
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_SKIA_CHECK_VISITED "${target}")

    get_target_property(aliased_target "${target}" ALIASED_TARGET)
    if (aliased_target)
        set(target "${aliased_target}")
    endif()
    if ("${target}" STREQUAL "${SKIA_TARGET}")
        set("${output}" "${chain}" PARENT_SCOPE)
        return()
    endif()

    get_target_property(type "${target}" TYPE)
    set(dependencies "")
    if (NOT "${type}" STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY")
        get_target_property(link_libraries "${target}" LINK_LIBRARIES)
        if (link_libraries)
            list(APPEND dependencies ${link_libraries})
        endif()
    endif()
    get_target_property(interface_link_libraries "${target}" INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
    if (interface_link_libraries)
        list(APPEND dependencies ${interface_link_libraries})
    endif()

    foreach (dependency IN LISTS dependencies)
        # A static library passes its private dependencies on as $<LINK_ONLY:...>. Other generator expressions do not
        # name Skia.
        string(REGEX REPLACE "^\\$<LINK_ONLY:(.+)>$" "\\1" dependency "${dependency}")
        if (dependency MATCHES "^\\$<" OR NOT TARGET "${dependency}")
            continue()
        endif()
        _ladybird_skia_link_path("${dependency}" "${chain} -> ${dependency}" found_chain)
        if (found_chain)
            set("${output}" "${found_chain}" PARENT_SCOPE)
            return()
        endif()
    endforeach()
endfunction()

function(ladybird_check_skia_confinement)
    foreach (target IN LISTS ARGN)
        if (NOT TARGET "${target}")
            continue()
        endif()
        set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_SKIA_CHECK_VISITED "")
        _ladybird_skia_link_path("${target}" "${target}" chain)
        if (chain)
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Only the Compositor may link Skia, but ${target} reaches it: ${chain}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
endfunction()

#
# Finds clang and llvm development packages that match the current clang version
#

if (NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang$")
    return()
endif()

set(DESIRED_CLANG_VERSION "${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION}")

# find zstd package before clang so that it is built fully and not
# specifically for clang's use. Clang/LLVM requires zstd and it's cmake
# will build zstd if not available, but clang's cmake will incorrectly
# build zstd for curl 8.18.0, which also depends on zstd.
#
# see https://github.com/LadybirdBrowser/ladybird/pull/7738
# related to https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/issues/139666
find_package(zstd QUIET CONFIG REQUIRED)

find_package(Clang "${DESIRED_CLANG_VERSION}" QUIET REQUIRED CONFIG)
find_package(LLVM "${DESIRED_CLANG_VERSION}" QUIET REQUIRED CONFIG)

FILE: Meta/CMake/code_generators.cmake
#
# Functions for generating sources using host tools
#

function(embed_as_string name source_file output source_variable_name)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 4 EMBED_STRING_VIEW "" "NAMESPACE" "")
    set(namespace_arg "")
    if (EMBED_STRING_VIEW_NAMESPACE)
        set(namespace_arg "-s ${EMBED_STRING_VIEW_NAMESPACE}")
    endif()
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${output}"
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/embed_as_string.py" "${source_file}" -o "${output}.tmp" -n "${source_variable_name}" ${namespace_arg}
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "${output}.tmp" "${output}"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E remove "${output}.tmp"
        VERBATIM
        DEPENDS "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/embed_as_string.py"
        MAIN_DEPENDENCY "${source_file}"
    )

    add_custom_target("generate_${name}" DEPENDS "${output}")
    add_dependencies(ladybird_codegen_accumulator "generate_${name}")
endfunction()

function(compile_ipc source output)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 2 ARG "" "RUST_OUTPUT" "")
    if (NOT IS_ABSOLUTE ${source})
        set(source ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${source})
    endif()
    if (NOT IS_ABSOLUTE ${output})
        set(output ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${output})
    endif()
    cmake_path(REPLACE_EXTENSION output LAST_ONLY .cpp OUTPUT_VARIABLE implementation)
    get_filename_component(output_name ${output} NAME)
    cmake_path(RELATIVE_PATH CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR BASE_DIRECTORY ${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR} OUTPUT_VARIABLE current_source_dir_relative)
    set(library_arguments)
    if (current_source_dir_relative MATCHES "^Libraries/(Lib[^/]+)(/|$)")
        # NB: The library is defined after its IPC files, so its export macro is only known when the build is generated.
        list(APPEND library_arguments --library ${CMAKE_MATCH_1} "--export-macro=$<TARGET_PROPERTY:${CMAKE_MATCH_1},LADYBIRD_EXPORT_MACRO>")
        set(GENERATED_IPC TRUE PARENT_SCOPE)
    endif()
    set(rust_arguments)
    set(rust_output)
    set(rust_commands)
    if (ARG_RUST_OUTPUT)
        get_filename_component(rust_output "${ARG_RUST_OUTPUT}" ABSOLUTE BASE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
        list(APPEND rust_arguments --rust-output ${rust_output}.tmp)
        list(APPEND rust_commands
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different ${rust_output}.tmp ${rust_output}
            COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E remove ${rust_output}.tmp)
    endif()
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${output} ${implementation} ${rust_output}
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/generate_ipc_definitions.py"
            --input ${source} --output ${output}.tmp --implementation ${implementation}.tmp
            --header-name ${output_name} ${library_arguments} ${rust_arguments}
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different ${output}.tmp ${output}
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different ${implementation}.tmp ${implementation}
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E remove ${output}.tmp ${implementation}.tmp
        ${rust_commands}
        VERBATIM
        DEPENDS "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/generate_ipc_definitions.py"
            "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/lexer.py"
            "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/utils.py"
        MAIN_DEPENDENCY ${source}
    )
    add_custom_target(generate_${output_name} DEPENDS ${output} ${implementation} ${rust_output})
    add_dependencies(ladybird_codegen_accumulator generate_${output_name})
    list(APPEND SOURCES ${implementation})
    set(SOURCES ${SOURCES} PARENT_SCOPE)

    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
        # NB: A header generated into a subdirectory of the library is installed into the same subdirectory, where
        #     the library's headers include it from.
        get_filename_component(output_directory ${output} DIRECTORY)
        file(RELATIVE_PATH output_subdirectory ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR} ${output_directory})
        if (output_subdirectory MATCHES "^\\.\\.")
            set(output_subdirectory "")
        endif()
        install(FILES ${output} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${current_source_dir_relative}/${output_subdirectory}" OPTIONAL)
    endif()
endfunction()

# Flags shared by Lagom and Ladybird.
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

set(CMAKE_CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES OFF)

set(CMAKE_COLOR_DIAGNOSTICS ON)

macro(add_cxx_compile_options)
    set(args "")
    foreach(arg ${ARGN})
        string(APPEND args ${arg}$<SEMICOLON>)
    endforeach()
    add_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX,ASM>:${args}>)
endmacro()

# For options that only mean something to C++, some of which GCC rejects when it compiles C.
macro(add_cxx_only_compile_options)
    set(args "")
    foreach(arg ${ARGN})
        string(APPEND args ${arg}$<SEMICOLON>)
    endforeach()
    add_compile_options($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:${args}>)
endmacro()

macro(add_cxx_compile_definitions)
    set(args "")
    foreach(arg ${ARGN})
        string(APPEND args ${arg}$<SEMICOLON>)
    endforeach()
    add_compile_definitions($<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX,ASM>:${args}>)
endmacro()

macro(add_cxx_link_options)
    set(args "")
    foreach(arg ${ARGN})
        string(APPEND args ${arg}$<SEMICOLON>)
    endforeach()
    add_link_options($<$<LINK_LANGUAGE:C,CXX>:${args}>)
endmacro()

include(CheckLinkerFlag)
include(CMakePushCheckState)
function(add_cxx_link_option_if_supported option)
    cmake_push_check_state()
    if (MSVC)
        set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LINK_OPTIONS /WX)
    else()
        set(CMAKE_REQUIRED_LINK_OPTIONS -Werror)
    endif()
    check_linker_flag(CXX ${option} LAGOM_LINKER_SUPPORTS_${option})
    if (${LAGOM_LINKER_SUPPORTS_${option}})
        add_cxx_link_options(${option})
    endif()
    cmake_pop_check_state()
endfunction()

# RUSTC_TARGET_CPU_FLAGS names the same CPU for rustc, so that Rust code runs on the instruction set C++ code does.
if (LADYBIRD_BASELINE_CPU_TARGET)
    # Binaries that run on other machines, and ccache caches that different runners share, need a common architecture.
    if (APPLE AND CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "arm64")
        add_cxx_compile_options(-mcpu=apple-m1)
        set(RUSTC_TARGET_CPU_FLAGS -Ctarget-cpu=apple-m1)
    elseif (CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(aarch64|arm64)$")
        add_cxx_compile_options(-march=armv8.2-a)
        set(RUSTC_TARGET_CPU_FLAGS -Ctarget-feature=+v8.2a)
    elseif (CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|amd64|AMD64)$")
        # Keep distributed binaries usable on SSE4.2/POPCNT machines without AVX or BMI.
        add_cxx_compile_options(-march=x86-64-v2)
        set(RUSTC_TARGET_CPU_FLAGS -Ctarget-cpu=x86-64-v2)
    endif()
elseif (CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR STREQUAL "riscv64")
    # On RISC-V the generic -march=native is not yet supported and both gcc and clang require an explicit
    # ISA or target string. Unfortunately hardware probing is also neither easy nor reliable at the moment.
    # For the time being use the defaults for the best compatibility with existing hardware and toolchains.
    # FIXME: Remove this branch once -march=native is supported.
elseif (NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    # In all other cases, compile for the native architecture of the host system.
    add_cxx_compile_options(-march=native)
    set(RUSTC_TARGET_CPU_FLAGS -Ctarget-cpu=native)
endif()

# Stack walks such as the crash handler's follow frame pointers. Apple platforms keep them by default, and Windows
# unwinds through the unwind tables its ABI requires instead, so only other platforms need to ask for them.
if (NOT APPLE AND NOT WIN32)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    set(RUSTC_TARGET_FRAME_POINTER_FLAGS -Cforce-frame-pointers=yes)
endif()

add_cxx_compile_options(-Wcast-qual)
add_cxx_compile_options(-Wformat=2)
add_cxx_compile_options(-Wimplicit-fallthrough)
add_cxx_compile_options(-Wlogical-op)
add_cxx_compile_options(-Wmissing-declarations)
add_cxx_compile_options(-Wmissing-field-initializers)
if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "AppleClang")
    # Apple Clang does not include this diagnostic in -Wmissing-field-initializers as upstream Clang does.
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wmissing-designated-field-initializers)
endif()
add_cxx_only_compile_options(-Wsuggest-override)

add_cxx_only_compile_options(-Wno-invalid-offsetof)
add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-maybe-uninitialized)
add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-shorten-64-to-32)
add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-unknown-warning-option)
add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-unused-command-line-argument)
add_cxx_only_compile_options(-Wno-user-defined-literals)

add_cxx_compile_options(-Werror)

if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wpadded-bitfield)
endif()

if (NOT MSVC)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fno-exceptions)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-ffp-contract=off)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fstrict-flex-arrays=2)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fstack-protector-strong)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fsigned-char)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-ftrivial-auto-var-init=zero)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-ggnu-pubnames)
    add_cxx_link_options(-fstack-protector-strong)
    if (UNIX AND NOT APPLE AND NOT ENABLE_FUZZERS)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-fno-semantic-interposition)
        add_cxx_only_compile_options(-fvisibility-inlines-hidden)
    endif()
endif()

if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-implicit-const-int-float-conversion)
    add_cxx_only_compile_options(-Wno-unqualified-std-cast-call)

    # Used for the #embed directive.
    # FIXME: Remove this once #embed is no longer an extension.
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-c23-extensions)
endif()

if (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang" AND NOT MSVC)
    # Clang's default constexpr-steps limit is 1048576(2^20), GCC doesn't have one
    add_cxx_only_compile_options(-fconstexpr-steps=16777216)

    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wmissing-prototypes)
elseif (CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU")
    add_cxx_only_compile_options(-Wno-literal-suffix)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wvla)

    # FIXME: These warnings trigger on Function and ByteBuffer in GCC (only when LTO is disabled...)
    #        investigate this and maybe reenable them if they're not false positives/invalid.
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-array-bounds)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-stringop-overflow)

    # FIXME: This warning seems useful but has too many false positives with GCC 13.
    add_cxx_only_compile_options(-Wno-dangling-reference)
elseif (MSVC)
    # Warning options and defines
    add_cxx_compile_options(/W4)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-reserved-identifier)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-Wno-microsoft-unqualified-friend) # MSVC doesn't support unqualified friends
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS) # _s replacements not desired (or implemented on any other platform other than VxWorks)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(_CRT_NONSTDC_NO_WARNINGS) # POSIX names are just fine, thanks

    # Windows API defines
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(_USE_MATH_DEFINES)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(NOMINMAX)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(_WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(WINVER=0x0A00)

    # TODO: Use export macros everywhere
    set(CMAKE_WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON)

    # full symbolic debugginng information
    add_cxx_compile_options(/Z7)

    # Compiler options
    # disable exceptions
    add_cxx_compile_options(/EHs-)
    # disable floating-point expression contraction, which the default /fp:precise allows
    add_cxx_compile_options(/clang:-ffp-contract=off)
    # reduces object size
    add_cxx_compile_options(/Zc:inline)
    # equivalent of -fvisibility-inlines-hidden
    add_cxx_compile_options(/Zc:dllexportInlines-)
    # clang-cl has this off by default unlike other clang versions
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fstrict-aliasing)
    add_cxx_compile_options(/clang:-fstrict-flex-arrays=2)
    add_cxx_compile_options(/clang:-ftrivial-auto-var-init=zero)
    # create COMDATs from functions and data, enables deduplication
    add_cxx_compile_options(/Gw)
    add_cxx_compile_options(/Gy)
    # enable control flow protection
    add_cxx_compile_options(/guard:cf)

    # Linker options
    # increase stack size reserve to match Linux
    add_cxx_link_options(/STACK:0x800000)
    # enable control flow protection
    add_cxx_link_options(/GUARD:CF)
    add_cxx_link_option_if_supported(-prefetch-inputs)

    # Use ghash compressed debug info for build time and pdb size reduction
    if (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "RelWithDebInfo" OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
        add_cxx_compile_options(-gcodeview-ghash)
        add_cxx_link_options(/DEBUG:GHASH)
    endif()
endif()

if (LINUX)
    # Some distributions' compilers define _FORTIFY_SOURCE themselves, and a different value than ours is an error.
    add_cxx_compile_options(-U_FORTIFY_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=3)
    add_cxx_compile_definitions(_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fstack-clash-protection)
    add_cxx_link_option_if_supported(LINKER:-z,relro)
    add_cxx_link_option_if_supported(LINKER:-z,now)

    # glibc older than 2.36 cannot load binaries with packed relative relocations, but linkers can still produce them.
    # The checks are nested because __GLIBC_PREREQ(2, 36) does not parse in an #if where the macro is not defined.
    check_cxx_source_compiles("
        #include <features.h>
        #ifdef __GLIBC__
        #    if !__GLIBC_PREREQ(2, 36)
        #        error glibc is too old to load packed relative relocations
        #    endif
        #endif
        int main() { }
    " LAGOM_LIBC_SUPPORTS_PACKED_RELATIVE_RELOCS)
    if (LAGOM_LIBC_SUPPORTS_PACKED_RELATIVE_RELOCS)
        add_cxx_link_option_if_supported(LINKER:-z,pack-relative-relocs)
    endif()
endif()

    list(APPEND CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH /opt/homebrew)

        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lto")

    endif()

if (NOT WIN32 AND NOT APPLE AND NOT ENABLE_FUZZERS)
    # NOTE: Assume ELF
    # NOTE: --no-undefined is not compatible with clang sanitizer runtimes
    # NOTE: Some BSDs don't export all symbols from LibC so we can't use --no-undefined
    if ((CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang$" AND (ENABLE_ADDRESS_SANITIZER OR ENABLE_MEMORY_SANITIZER OR ENABLE_THREAD_SANITIZER OR ENABLE_UNDEFINED_SANITIZER OR ENABLE_LAGOM_COVERAGE_COLLECTION)) OR BSD)
        add_link_options(LINKER:--allow-shlib-undefined)
        add_link_options(LINKER:-z,undefs)
    else()
        add_link_options(LINKER:-z,defs)
        add_link_options(LINKER:--no-undefined)
        add_link_options(LINKER:--no-allow-shlib-undefined)
    endif()
endif()

if (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
    if (NOT MSVC)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-ggdb3)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-Og)
    endif()
elseif (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "RelWithDebInfo")
    if (NOT MSVC)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-O2)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-g1)
    else()
        # Add OPT:REF either way as it doesn't impact debugging experience negatively and decreases binary size
        # see: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/build/reference/opt-optimizations?view=msvc-170
        # This doesn't play nicely with ASAN
        if (NOT ENABLE_ADDRESS_SANITIZER)
            add_cxx_link_options(/OPT:REF)
        endif()
        # Override /Ob1 that cmake adds to allow inlining on all functions.
        # This makes debugging worse but is closer to a normal build for profiling and testing.
        add_cxx_compile_options(/O2)
    endif()
elseif (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Release")
    if (NOT MSVC)
        add_cxx_compile_options(-O3)

        # Line tables, inlined frames included, are what symbolicating a crash report needs.
        if (LADYBIRD_GENERATE_SYMBOL_FILES)
            add_cxx_compile_options(-g1)
        endif()
    else()
        add_cxx_compile_options(/O2)
    endif()
endif()

    else()

    endif()
endif()

        add_cxx_link_options(-fprofile-instr-generate)
    else()
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "Collecting code coverage is unsupported in this configuration.")
    endif()

# Runs while CPack packages, once the files of the package are staged. A Linux package says which kind it is, so that
# the browser in it can tell how to update it: the same build can also end up in an archive.
set(marker "${CPACK_TEMPORARY_DIRECTORY}/Browser${CPACK_PACKAGING_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${CPACK_LADYBIRD_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY}/package-format")
file(WRITE "${marker}" "${CPACK_GENERATOR}\n")
file(CHMOD "${marker}" PERMISSIONS OWNER_READ OWNER_WRITE GROUP_READ WORLD_READ)

FILE: Meta/CMake/cpack_project_config.cmake
# The archives keep a relocatable layout of Ladybird's components, while the Linux packages install into a fixed
# directory and group the components into the browser package and its debug symbols package.
if (CPACK_GENERATOR MATCHES "^(DEB|RPM)$")
    set(CPACK_PACKAGING_INSTALL_PREFIX "${CPACK_LADYBIRD_PACKAGE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
    set(CPACK_PACKAGE_RELOCATABLE OFF)
    set(CPACK_COMPONENT_LADYBIRD_RUNTIME_GROUP Browser)
    set(CPACK_COMPONENT_LADYBIRD_SYSTEMINTEGRATION_GROUP Browser)
    set(CPACK_COMPONENT_LADYBIRD_SYSTEMSYMBOLS_GROUP DebugSymbols)
    set(CPACK_PRE_BUILD_SCRIPTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cpack_package_format.cmake")
endif()

# A Linux package targets the ABI of the distribution that built it, so its version names that distribution version:
# Debian packages like Ubuntu's backports do, RPM packages with the dist tag of rpmbuild. Builds for several versions
# of a distribution can then share a repository, and upgrading the distribution also moves Ladybird to the build for it.
if (CPACK_GENERATOR STREQUAL "DEB")
    file(STRINGS /etc/os-release os_release REGEX "^(ID|VERSION_ID)=")
    foreach (line IN LISTS os_release)
        if (line MATCHES "^(ID|VERSION_ID)=\"?([^\"]*)\"?$")
            set(os_release_${CMAKE_MATCH_1} "${CMAKE_MATCH_2}")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_RELEASE "1~${os_release_ID}${os_release_VERSION_ID}")
    set(CPACK_DEBIAN_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_DEPENDS
        "ladybird (= ${CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION}-${CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_RELEASE})")
endif()

if (NOT DEFINED ENV{LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR} OR "$ENV{LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    set(ENV{LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR} "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()

    set(ENV{LADYBIRD_MAIN_SOURCE_DIR} "$ENV{LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()

set(LADYBIRD_CACHE_DIR "$ENV{LADYBIRD_MAIN_SOURCE_DIR}/Build/caches" CACHE STRING "")

if (DEFINED LADYBIRD_VCPKG_TYPE)
    if (NOT DEFINED ENV{VCPKG_ROOT} OR "$ENV{VCPKG_ROOT}" STREQUAL "")
        set(ENV{VCPKG_ROOT} "$ENV{LADYBIRD_MAIN_SOURCE_DIR}/Build/vcpkg-${LADYBIRD_VCPKG_TYPE}")
    endif()

    set(CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE "$ENV{VCPKG_ROOT}/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
    set(VCPKG_INSTALL_OPTIONS "--no-print-usage" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
    if (CMAKE_HOST_APPLE)
        # Installed files are hard links to their copies in packages/, and macOS can resolve @loader_path through either
        # name. From packages/, host tools like Qt's moc can't find the libraries they link.
        set(VCPKG_INSTALL_OPTIONS "${VCPKG_INSTALL_OPTIONS};--clean-packages-after-build" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
    endif()

    # Each optional dependency is a feature of vcpkg.json that an option selects. The options are declared after
    # project(), so one that is not set yet has its default. Keep in sync with MANIFEST_FEATURE_OPTIONS in
    # Meta/Utils/vcpkg_deps.py.
    if (LADYBIRD_BUILD_QT AND (NOT DEFINED ENABLE_GUI_TARGETS OR ENABLE_GUI_TARGETS))
        list(APPEND VCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES "qt")
    endif()
    if ((NOT DEFINED LADYBIRD_ENABLE_UPDATE_CHECK OR LADYBIRD_ENABLE_UPDATE_CHECK)
        AND (NOT DEFINED LADYBIRD_ENABLE_SPARKLE OR LADYBIRD_ENABLE_SPARKLE))
        list(APPEND VCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES "sparkle")
    endif()

    set(VCPKG_OVERLAY_TRIPLETS "$ENV{LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/CMake/vcpkg/${LADYBIRD_VCPKG_TYPE}-triplets" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)

    set(ENV{VCPKG_BINARY_SOURCES} "clear;files,${LADYBIRD_CACHE_DIR}/vcpkg-binary-cache,readwrite;$ENV{VCPKG_BINARY_SOURCES}")
    set(asset_sources "clear;x-azurl,https://vcpkg-assets.ladybird.org/source-assets/,,read")
    if (NOT "$ENV{VCPKG_ASSET_WRITE_URL}" STREQUAL "")
        string(APPEND asset_sources ";x-azurl,$ENV{VCPKG_ASSET_WRITE_URL},,write")
    endif()
    set(ENV{X_VCPKG_ASSET_SOURCES} "${asset_sources}")
endif()

#[=======================================================================[.rst:
FindWebP
--------------

Find WebP headers and libraries.

Imported Targets
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

``WebP::webp``
  The WebP library, if found.

``WebP::webpdemux``
  The WebP demux library, if found.

``WebP::libwebpmux``
  The WebP mux library, if found.

``WebP::webpdecoder``
  The WebP decoder library, if found.

Result Variables
^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

This will define the following variables in your project:

``WebP_FOUND``
  true if (the requested version of) WebP is available.
``WebP_VERSION``
  the version of WebP.
``WebP_LIBRARIES``
  the libraries to link against to use WebP.
``WebP_INCLUDE_DIRS``
  where to find the WebP headers.
``WebP_COMPILE_OPTIONS``
  this should be passed to target_compile_options(), if the
  target is not used for linking

#]=======================================================================]

find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
pkg_check_modules(PC_WEBP QUIET libwebp)
set(WebP_COMPILE_OPTIONS ${PC_WEBP_CFLAGS_OTHER})
set(WebP_VERSION ${PC_WEBP_CFLAGS_VERSION})

find_path(WebP_INCLUDE_DIR
    NAMES webp/encode.h
    HINTS ${PC_WEBP_INCLUDEDIR} ${PC_WEBP_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)

find_library(WebP_LIBRARY
    NAMES ${WebP_NAMES} webp libwebp
    HINTS ${PC_WEBP_LIBDIR} ${PC_WEBP_LIBRARY_DIRS}
)

# There's nothing in the WebP headers that could be used to detect the exact
# WebP version being used so don't attempt to do so. A version can only be found
# through pkg-config
if ("${WebP_FIND_VERSION}" VERSION_GREATER "${WebP_VERSION}")
    if (WebP_VERSION)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Required version (" ${WebP_FIND_VERSION} ") is higher than found version (" ${WebP_VERSION} ")")
    else ()
        message(WARNING "Cannot determine WebP version without pkg-config")
    endif ()
endif ()

# Find components
if (WebP_INCLUDE_DIR AND WebP_LIBRARY)
    set(_WebP_REQUIRED_LIBS_FOUND ON)
    set(WebP_LIBS_FOUND "WebP (required): ${WebP_LIBRARY}")
else ()
    set(_WebP_REQUIRED_LIBS_FOUND OFF)
    set(WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND "WebP (required)")
endif ()

find_library(WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY
    NAMES ${WebP_DEMUX_NAMES} webpdemux libwebpdemux
    HINTS ${PC_WEBP_LIBDIR} ${PC_WEBP_LIBRARY_DIRS}
)

if (WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY)
    if (WebP_FIND_REQUIRED_webpdemux)
        list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_FOUND "webpdemux (required): ${WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY}")
    else ()
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_FOUND "webpdemux (optional): ${WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY}")
    endif ()
else ()
    if (WebP_FIND_REQUIRED_webpdemux)
       set(_WebP_REQUIRED_LIBS_FOUND OFF)
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND "webpdemux (required)")
    else ()
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND "webpdemux (optional)")
    endif ()
endif ()

find_library(WebP_MUX_LIBRARY
    NAMES ${WebP_MUX_NAMES} webpmux libwebpmux
    HINTS ${PC_WEBP_LIBDIR} ${PC_WEBP_LIBRARY_DIRS}
)

if (WebP_MUX_LIBRARY)
    if (WebP_FIND_REQUIRED_libwebpmux)
        list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_FOUND "mux (required): ${WebP_MUX_LIBRARY}")
    else ()
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_FOUND "mux (optional): ${WebP_MUX_LIBRARY}")
    endif ()
else ()
    if (WebP_FIND_REQUIRED_libwebpmux)
       set(_WebP_REQUIRED_LIBS_FOUND OFF)
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND "mux (required)")
    else ()
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND "mux (optional)")
    endif ()
endif ()

find_library(WebP_DECODER_LIBRARY
    NAMES ${WebP_DECODER_NAMES} webpdecoder libwebpdecoder
    HINTS ${PC_WEBP_LIBDIR} ${PC_WEBP_LIBRARY_DIRS}
)

if (WebP_DECODER_LIBRARY)
    if (WebP_FIND_REQUIRED_webpdecoder)
        list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_FOUND "decoder (required): ${WebP_DECODER_LIBRARY}")
    else ()
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_FOUND "decoder (optional): ${WebP_DECODER_LIBRARY}")
    endif ()
else ()
    if (WebP_FIND_REQUIRED_webpdecoder)
       set(_WebP_REQUIRED_LIBS_FOUND OFF)
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND "decoder (required)")
    else ()
       list(APPEND WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND "decoder (optional)")
    endif ()
endif ()

if (NOT WebP_FIND_QUIETLY)
    if (WebP_LIBS_FOUND)
        message(STATUS "Found the following WebP libraries:")
        foreach (found ${WebP_LIBS_FOUND})
            message(STATUS " ${found}")
        endforeach ()
    endif ()
    if (WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND)
        message(STATUS "The following WebP libraries were not found:")
        foreach (found ${WebP_LIBS_NOT_FOUND})
            message(STATUS " ${found}")
        endforeach ()
    endif ()
endif ()

include(FindPackageHandleStandardArgs)
find_package_handle_standard_args(WebP
    FOUND_VAR WebP_FOUND
    REQUIRED_VARS WebP_INCLUDE_DIR WebP_LIBRARY _WebP_REQUIRED_LIBS_FOUND
    VERSION_VAR WebP_VERSION
)

if (WebP_LIBRARY AND NOT TARGET WebP::webp)
    add_library(WebP::webp UNKNOWN IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(WebP::webp PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${WebP_LIBRARY}"
        INTERFACE_COMPILE_OPTIONS "${WebP_COMPILE_OPTIONS}"
        INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${WebP_INCLUDE_DIR}"
    )
endif ()

if (WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY AND NOT TARGET WebP::webpdemux)
    add_library(WebP::webpdemux UNKNOWN IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(WebP::webpdemux PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY}"
        INTERFACE_COMPILE_OPTIONS "${WebP_COMPILE_OPTIONS}"
        INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${WebP_INCLUDE_DIR}"
    )
    target_link_libraries(WebP::webpdemux INTERFACE WebP::webp)
endif ()

if (WebP_MUX_LIBRARY AND NOT TARGET WebP::libwebpmux)
    add_library(WebP::libwebpmux UNKNOWN IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(WebP::libwebpmux PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${WebP_MUX_LIBRARY}"
        INTERFACE_COMPILE_OPTIONS "${WebP_COMPILE_OPTIONS}"
        INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${WebP_INCLUDE_DIR}"
    )
    target_link_libraries(WebP::libwebpmux INTERFACE WebP::webp)
endif ()

if (WebP_DECODER_LIBRARY AND NOT TARGET WebP::webpdecoder)
    add_library(WebP::webpdecoder UNKNOWN IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(WebP::webpdecoder PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${WebP_DECODER_LIBRARY}"
        INTERFACE_COMPILE_OPTIONS "${WebP_COMPILE_OPTIONS}"
        INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${WebP_INCLUDE_DIR}"
    )
    target_link_libraries(WebP::webpdecoder INTERFACE WebP::webp)
endif ()

mark_as_advanced(
    WebP_INCLUDE_DIR
    WebP_LIBRARY
    WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY
    WebP_MUX_LIBRARY
    WebP_DECODER_LIBRARY
)

if (WebP_FOUND)
    set(WebP_LIBRARIES ${WebP_LIBRARY} ${WebP_DEMUX_LIBRARY} ${WebP_MUX_LIBRARY} ${WebP_DECODER_LIBRARY})
    set(WebP_INCLUDE_DIRS ${WebP_INCLUDE_DIR})
endif ()

FILE: Meta/CMake/flatpak/angle/angle-install.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e

cd angle

# Headers
pushd include
    find . -type f -and -name "*.h" -exec install -D -m644 {} "$FLATPAK_DEST/include/angle/"{} \;
popd

# Libraries
libs=(
  libEGL.so
  libGLESv1_CM.so
  libGLESv2.so
  libchrome_zlib.so
  libfeature_support.so
  libthird_party_abseil-cpp_absl.so
)

for lib in "${libs[@]}"; do
    install -D -m644 out/"$lib" "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib/$lib"
done

# Licenses: flatpak-builder only records those at the top of a module's source, and ANGLE is checked out below it,
# with the third-party code that it builds in.
licenses="$FLATPAK_DEST/share/licenses/$FLATPAK_ID/angle"
install -D -m644 LICENSE "$licenses/LICENSE"
shopt -s nullglob
# Some keep their license texts in a LICENSES directory.
for license in {,src/,src/common/}third_party/*/{LICENSE,COPYING}* third_party/*/{src,source}/{LICENSE,COPYING}*; do
    for file in "$license" "$license"/*; do
        [[ -f "$file" ]] && install -D -m644 "$file" "$licenses/${file//\//_}"
    done
done
shopt -u nullglob

# Pkg-config
mkdir -p "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib/pkgconfig"
cat > "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib/pkgconfig/angle.pc" <<EOF
    prefix=${FLATPAK_DEST}
    exec_prefix=\${prefix}
    libdir=\${prefix}/lib
    includedir=\${prefix}/include
    Name: angle
    Description: A conformant OpenGL ES implementation for Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS and Android.
    URL: https://angleproject.org/
    Version: 7258
    Libs: -L\${libdir} -lEGL -lGLESv2
    Cflags: -I\${includedir}/angle
EOF

FILE: Meta/CMake/flatpak/generate-cargo-sources.py
#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause

# Generate cargo-sources.json for Flatpak builds from Cargo.lock.
# Run this script whenever Rust dependencies change.

import argparse
import json
import re
import sys

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

script_dir = Path(__file__).parent
repo_root = script_dir / ".." / ".." / ".."
lock_path = repo_root / "Cargo.lock"
out_path = script_dir / "cargo-sources.json"


def generate(lock: str) -> str:
    crates = []
    for m in re.finditer(
        r'name = "(.+?)"\nversion = "(.+?)"\nsource = "registry.+?"\nchecksum = "(.+?)"',
        lock,
    ):
        crates.append((m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)))

    sources: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
        {
            "type": "git",
            "url": "https://github.com/corrosion-rs/corrosion.git",
            "tag": "v0.5.1",
            "dest": "corrosion",
        },
    ]

    for name, version, checksum in crates:
        sources.append(
            {
                "type": "archive",
                "archive-type": "tar-gzip",
                "url": f"https://static.crates.io/crates/{name}/{name}-{version}.crate",
                "sha256": checksum,
                "dest": f"cargo/vendor/{name}-{version}",
            }
        )

    checksum_commands = []
    for name, version, checksum in crates:
        d = f"cargo/vendor/{name}-{version}"
        checksum_json = json.dumps({"files": {}, "package": checksum})
        checksum_commands.append(f"echo '{checksum_json}' > {d}/.cargo-checksum.json")

    cargo_config = '[source.crates-io]\\nreplace-with = "vendored-sources"\\n\\n[source.vendored-sources]\\ndirectory = "cargo/vendor"\\n'

    sources.append(
        {
            "type": "shell",
            "commands": [
                *checksum_commands,
                "mkdir -p .cargo",
                f"printf '{cargo_config}' > .cargo/config.toml",
            ],
        }
    )

    return json.dumps(sources, indent=4) + "\n"


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate cargo-sources.json for Flatpak builds from Cargo.lock.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--check", action="store_true", help="only check that cargo-sources.json matches Cargo.lock, without writing it"
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    sources = generate(lock_path.read_text())
    if args.check:
        if not out_path.exists() or out_path.read_text() != sources:
            script = Path(__file__).resolve().relative_to(repo_root.resolve())
            print(f"{out_path.name} does not match Cargo.lock; run {script} to update it.")
            sys.exit(1)
        return

    out_path.write_text(sources)
    print(f"Generated {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e

REV_SHORT=97b68a0 # 97b68a0bb62b7528bc3491c7949d6804223c2b82
REV_NUM=2255 # git describe HEAD --match initial-commit | cut -d- -f3

env CC=gcc CXX=g++ python3 build/gen.py --no-last-commit-position

cat > out/last_commit_position.h <<EOF
    #ifndef OUT_LAST_COMMIT_POSITION_H_
    #define OUT_LAST_COMMIT_POSITION_H_

    #define LAST_COMMIT_POSITION_NUM ${REV_NUM}
    #define LAST_COMMIT_POSITION "${REV_NUM} (${REV_SHORT})"

    #endif  // OUT_LAST_COMMIT_POSITION_H_
EOF

ninja -j"$(nproc)" -C out

cp -v out/gn "$FLATPAK_DEST"/bin/

FILE: Meta/CMake/flatpak/skia/skia-install.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -e

# Libs
mkdir -p "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib"
for path in out/*.a out/*.so; do
    install -Dm644 "$path" "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib/$(basename "$path")"
done

# Includes
mkdir -p "$FLATPAK_DEST/include/skia/modules"
pushd include
    find . -name '*.h' -exec install -Dm644 {} "$FLATPAK_DEST/include/skia/{}" \;
popd
pushd modules
    find . -name '*.h' -exec install -Dm644 {} "$FLATPAK_DEST/include/skia/modules/{}" \;
popd

# Pkg-config
mkdir -p "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib/pkgconfig"
cat > "$FLATPAK_DEST/lib/pkgconfig/skia.pc" <<EOF
    prefix=${FLATPAK_DEST}
    exec_prefix=\${prefix}
    libdir=\${prefix}/lib
    includedir=\${prefix}/include/skia
    Name: skia
    Description: 2D graphic library for drawing text, geometries and images.
    URL: https://skia.org/
    Version: 148
    Libs: -L\${libdir} -lskia -lskcms
    Cflags: -I\${includedir}
EOF

# Some skia includes are assumed to be under an include sub directory by
# other includes
# shellcheck disable=SC2013
for file in $(grep -rl '#include "include/' "$FLATPAK_DEST/include/skia"); do
  sed -i -e 's|#include "include/|#include "|g' "$file"
done

FILE: Meta/CMake/get_linked_lagom_libraries.cmake
function(add_lagom_library list item)
    list(FIND "${list}" "${item}" item_is_present)

    if (item_is_present EQUAL -1)
        set("${list}" "${${list}}" "${item}" PARENT_SCOPE)
     endif()
endfunction()

function(get_linked_lagom_libraries_impl target output)
    if (NOT TARGET "${target}")
        return()
    endif()

    get_property(visited GLOBAL PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_LINKED_LAGOM_LIBRARIES_VISITED)
    if ("${target}" IN_LIST visited)
        return()
    endif()
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_LINKED_LAGOM_LIBRARIES_VISITED "${target}")

    get_target_property(target_is_imported "${target}" IMPORTED)
    if (target_is_imported)
        return()
    endif()

    get_target_property(target_type "${target}" TYPE)

    if ("${target_type}" STREQUAL "SHARED_LIBRARY")
        add_lagom_library("${output}" "${target}")
    elseif ("${target_type}" STREQUAL "INTERFACE_LIBRARY")
        return()
    endif()

    get_target_property(target_libraries "${target}" LINK_LIBRARIES)

    foreach(target_library IN LISTS target_libraries)
        get_linked_lagom_libraries_impl("${target_library}" "${output}")
    endforeach()

    set("${output}" "${${output}}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(get_linked_lagom_libraries target output)
    # Track all visited targets, including static libraries, separately from the shared libraries collected for installation.
    set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY _LADYBIRD_LINKED_LAGOM_LIBRARIES_VISITED "")

    get_linked_lagom_libraries_impl(${target} ${output})
    set("${output}" "${${output}}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
