================================================================================
FILE: Meta/CMake/install_vcpkg_libraries.cmake
include_guard()

# CMake collects runtime dependencies only on Windows, Linux and macOS.
# Windows is left out too, as its vcpkg DLLs live in bin/ and install as RUNTIME artifacts.
set(LADYBIRD_INSTALLS_VCPKG_LIBRARIES OFF)
if (CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "^(Linux|Darwin)$" AND NOT "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    set(LADYBIRD_INSTALLS_VCPKG_LIBRARIES ON)
endif()

function(ladybird_vcpkg_library_directory output_variable)
    set(vcpkg_library_dir "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/lib")
    if (NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "Release|RelWithDebInfo")
        set(vcpkg_library_dir "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/debug/lib")
    endif()
    set(${output_variable} "${vcpkg_library_dir}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

# Installs the shared libraries from vcpkg that the binaries in the runtime dependency set link. Call it after every
# install() that adds to the set.
function(ladybird_install_vcpkg_libraries dependency_set)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 1 ARG "" "DESTINATION;COMPONENT" "")

    ladybird_vcpkg_library_directory(vcpkg_library_dir)
    file(GLOB vcpkg_shared_libraries LIST_DIRECTORIES false
        "${vcpkg_library_dir}/*.dylib" "${vcpkg_library_dir}/*.so" "${vcpkg_library_dir}/*.so.*")

    set(system_library_regexes "")
    if (APPLE)
        # These are in the dyld shared cache rather than on disk.
        set(system_library_regexes "^/usr/lib/" "^/System/")
    endif()

    # A dependency found through a plugin's relative runpath can contain .. segments.
    install(RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY_SET ${dependency_set}
        PRE_EXCLUDE_REGEXES ${system_library_regexes}
        POST_INCLUDE_FILES ${vcpkg_shared_libraries}
        POST_EXCLUDE_REGEXES ".*"
        DIRECTORIES "${vcpkg_library_dir}"
        LIBRARY DESTINATION ${ARG_DESTINATION} COMPONENT ${ARG_COMPONENT}
    )

    # The libraries are installed under the names of the files they resolve to, yet binaries may link them through the
    # versioned links next to those files.
    install(CODE "
    set(library_install_dir \"\$ENV{DESTDIR}\${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${ARG_DESTINATION}\")
    file(GLOB links LIST_DIRECTORIES false \"${vcpkg_library_dir}/*\")
    foreach (link IN LISTS links)
      cmake_path(GET link FILENAME link_name)
      if (NOT IS_SYMLINK \"\${link}\" OR NOT link_name MATCHES \"\\\\.[0-9]+\\\\.dylib\$|\\\\.so\\\\.[0-9]+\")
        continue()
      endif()
      file(REAL_PATH \"\${link}\" target)
      cmake_path(GET target FILENAME target_name)
      if (EXISTS \"\${library_install_dir}/\${target_name}\" AND NOT link_name STREQUAL target_name)
        file(CREATE_LINK \"\${target_name}\" \"\${library_install_dir}/\${link_name}\" SYMBOLIC)
      endif()
    endforeach()
  "
            COMPONENT ${ARG_COMPONENT})
endfunction()

set(ladybird_helper_processes
    AudioServer
    Compositor
    Hub
    ImageDecoder
    MediaServer
    RequestServer
    SystemProbe
    VideoDecoderServer
    WebContent
    WebRTCClient
)

# Kills the helpers when the Browser is gone, which the kernel cannot do on macOS.
if (APPLE)
    list(APPEND ladybird_helper_processes ProcessReaper)
endif()

function(ladybird_write_entitlements path)
    set(plist "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC \"-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN\" \"http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd\">\n<plist version=\"1.0\">\n<dict>\n")
    foreach (entitlement IN LISTS ARGN)
        string(APPEND plist "\t<key>${entitlement}</key>\n\t<true/>\n")
    endforeach()
    string(APPEND plist "</dict>\n</plist>\n")
    file(WRITE "${path}" "${plist}")
endfunction()

# On macOS, helpers run with the hardened runtime, so the kernel refuses to run code from memory that was writable, except
# in the MAP_JIT regions where the renderers put the code that their JIT compilers generate. Library validation stays
# off, since development builds sign their libraries ad hoc, without a team identifier. Every build of the helper signs
# it, so that targeted builds keep these protections too. Release signing uses the .release.entitlements file instead:
# every library in a release bundle carries the same team identifier, so library validation stays on, and debuggers
# must not be able to attach.
function(ladybird_sign_helper_process target)
    if (NOT APPLE)
        return()
    endif()
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 1 ARG "ALLOW_JIT" "" "ENTITLEMENTS")

    set(entitlements com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation ${ARG_ENTITLEMENTS})
    if (ARG_ALLOW_JIT)
        list(APPEND entitlements com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit)
    endif()
    if (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "Debug|RelWithDebInfo")
        list(APPEND entitlements com.apple.security.get-task-allow)
    endif()

    set(entitlements_file "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${target}.entitlements")
    ladybird_write_entitlements("${entitlements_file}" ${entitlements})

    set(release_entitlements ${ARG_ENTITLEMENTS})
    if (ARG_ALLOW_JIT)
        list(APPEND release_entitlements com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit)
    endif()
    ladybird_write_entitlements("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${target}.release.entitlements" ${release_entitlements})
    install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${target}.release.entitlements" DESTINATION entitlements
        COMPONENT ladybird_Runtime)

    ladybird_codesign_command(codesign_command "${target}" --entitlements "${entitlements_file}" -o runtime "$<TARGET_FILE:${target}>")
    add_custom_command(TARGET ${target} POST_BUILD COMMAND ${codesign_command} VERBATIM)
endfunction()

FILE: Meta/CMake/lagom_install_options.cmake
include_guard()

include(GNUInstallDirs) # make sure to include before we mess w/RPATH

# Handle multi-config generators (e.g. MSVC, Xcode, Ninja Multi-Config)
get_property(is_multi_config GLOBAL PROPERTY GENERATOR_IS_MULTI_CONFIG)
set(IN_BUILD_PREFIX "")
if (is_multi_config)
    set(IN_BUILD_PREFIX "$<CONFIG>/")
endif()

# Mirror the structure of the installed tree to ensure that rpaths
# always remain valid.
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${IN_BUILD_PREFIX}${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}")
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${IN_BUILD_PREFIX}${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/${IN_BUILD_PREFIX}${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")

set(CMAKE_SKIP_BUILD_RPATH FALSE)

if ("${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH TRUE)
else()
    if (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE MATCHES "Release|RelWithDebInfo")
        set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/lib")
    else()
        set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/debug/lib")
    endif()
endif()

# See slide 100 of the following ppt :^)
# https://crascit.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/09/Deep-CMake-For-Library-Authors-Craig-Scott-CppCon-2019.pdf
if (APPLE)
    set(CMAKE_MACOSX_RPATH TRUE)
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_NAME_DIR "@rpath")
endif()

# Static builds without vcpkg install no libraries, so their executables have nothing to look for next to them.
if (BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OR NOT "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    if (APPLE)
        set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "@executable_path/../lib")
    else()
        set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN:$ORIGIN/../${CMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR}")
    endif()
endif()

# Installs carry the shared libraries from vcpkg, so they must not look for them in the build machine's vcpkg tree.
if ("${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH TRUE)
endif()

set(CMAKE_INSTALL_MESSAGE NEVER)

function (generate_css_implementation)

    invoke_py_generator(
        "DescriptorID.cpp"

    )

    invoke_py_generator(
        "Enums.cpp"

        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Enums.json"
        "CSS/Enums.h"
        "CSS/Enums.cpp"

                  -e "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/CSS/Enums.json"

    invoke_py_idl_generator(

       "CSS/TransformFunctions.h"
    )
    list(TRANSFORM CSS_GENERATED_HEADERS PREPEND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/")
    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
        install(FILES ${CSS_GENERATED_HEADERS} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWeb/CSS")
    endif()
    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${CSS_GENERATED_HEADERS})
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS} PARENT_SCOPE)

    set(CSS_GENERATED_IDL
        "GeneratedCSSNumericFactoryMethods.idl"
    )
    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_IDL ${CSS_GENERATED_IDL})
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_IDL ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_IDL} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function (generate_html_implementation)
    set(LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

    invoke_py_generator(
        "NamedCharacterReferences.cpp"
        "generate_libweb_html_named_character_references.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/Parser/Entities.json"
        "HTML/Parser/NamedCharacterReferences.h"
        "HTML/Parser/NamedCharacterReferences.cpp"
        arguments -j "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/Parser/Entities.json"
    )

    invoke_py_generator(
        "MediaControlsDOM.cpp"
        "generate_dom_tree.py"
        "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/MediaControls.html"
        "HTML/MediaControlsDOM.h"
        "HTML/MediaControlsDOM.cpp"
        arguments -i "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/MediaControls.html"
                  -s MediaControlsDOM
                  -n "Web::HTML"
                  --html-tags "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/TagNames.h"
                  --html-attributes "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/AttributeNames.h"
                  --svg-tags "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/SVG/TagNames.h"
                  --svg-attributes "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/SVG/AttributeNames.h"
        dependencies "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/TagNames.h"
                     "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/AttributeNames.h"
                     "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/SVG/TagNames.h"
                     "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/SVG/AttributeNames.h"
                     "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/HTML/MediaControls.css"
    )

    set(HTML_GENERATED_HEADERS
       "HTML/Parser/NamedCharacterReferences.h"
       "HTML/MediaControlsDOM.h"
    )
    list(TRANSFORM HTML_GENERATED_HEADERS PREPEND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/")
    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
        install(FILES ${HTML_GENERATED_HEADERS} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWeb/HTML")
    endif()
    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${HTML_GENERATED_HEADERS})
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

endfunction()

function (generate_js_bindings target)
    set(LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
    set(generated_idl_targets ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_IDL})
    list(TRANSFORM generated_idl_targets PREPEND "generate_")
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_BINDINGS_SOURCES)
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADERS)
    get_target_property(libwebcommon_binary_dir LibWebCommon BINARY_DIR)
    set(LIBWEB_COMMON_BINDINGS_DIRECTORY "${libwebcommon_binary_dir}/Bindings")
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES)
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES)
    macro(libweb_add_bindings_source class)
        get_filename_component(basename "${class}" NAME)

        set(BINDINGS_HEADER "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/${basename}.h")
        set(BINDINGS_SOURCE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/${basename}.cpp")
        set(BINDINGS_SOURCES ${BINDINGS_HEADER} ${BINDINGS_SOURCE})
        target_sources(${target} PRIVATE ${BINDINGS_SOURCES})

        if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
            install(FILES ${BINDINGS_HEADER} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWeb/Bindings")
        endif()

        list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${BINDINGS_HEADER})

        list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_BINDINGS_SOURCES ${BINDINGS_SOURCES})

        # The module's enumerations, which LibWebCommon provides so that processes without LibWeb can use them.
        set(COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADER "${LIBWEB_COMMON_BINDINGS_DIRECTORY}/${basename}.h")
        if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
            install(FILES ${COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADER} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWebCommon/Bindings")
        endif()
        list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADERS ${COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADER})
    endmacro()

    macro(libweb_js_bindings class)
        get_filename_component(basename "${class}" NAME)
        set(idl_path "${LIBWEB_INPUT_FOLDER}/${class}.idl")
        if ("${basename}.idl" IN_LIST LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_IDL)
            set(idl_path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${class}.idl")
        endif()

        libweb_add_bindings_source(${class})

        list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES "${idl_path}")

        list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES "${idl_path}")
    endmacro()

    set(bindings_generator "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/generate_libweb_bindings.py")
    set(bindings_generator_dependencies
        "${bindings_generator}"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/__init__.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/arguments.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/attributes.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/callback_interfaces.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/constants.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/constructors.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/context.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/cpp_types.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/default_values.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/extended_attributes.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/global_mixins.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/glue_headers.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/includes.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/interface_declaration.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/interfaces.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/intrinsics.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/iterables.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/json_conversions.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/named_and_indexed_properties.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/namespaces.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/operations.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/overload_resolution.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/realms.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_bindings.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_members.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_names.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_overloads.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_structured_serialize.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_to_idl_value.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_to_js_value.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_types.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/rust_usage.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/security_checks.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/to_idl_value.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/to_js_value.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Generators/libweb_bindings/wrappers.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/lexer.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/utils.py"
        "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/Utils/webidl_parser.py")

    set(exposed_interface_sources
        Forward.h
        IntrinsicDefinitions.cpp IntrinsicDefinitions.h
        AudioWorkletExposedInterfaces.cpp AudioWorkletExposedInterfaces.h
        DedicatedWorkerExposedInterfaces.cpp DedicatedWorkerExposedInterfaces.h
        SharedWorkerExposedInterfaces.cpp SharedWorkerExposedInterfaces.h
        WindowExposedInterfaces.cpp WindowExposedInterfaces.h
        WrapperFactory.cpp)
    list(TRANSFORM exposed_interface_sources PREPEND "Bindings/")
    target_sources(${target} PRIVATE ${exposed_interface_sources})

    set(exposed_interface_headers ${exposed_interface_sources})
    list(FILTER exposed_interface_headers INCLUDE REGEX "\.h$")
    list(TRANSFORM exposed_interface_headers PREPEND "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/")

    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
        install(FILES ${exposed_interface_headers} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWeb/Bindings")
    endif()

    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${exposed_interface_headers})
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS} PARENT_SCOPE)

    include("idl_files.cmake")
    list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES)

    set(GLOBAL_MIXIN_HEADERS
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/DedicatedWorkerGlobalScopeGlobalMixin.h"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/SharedWorkerGlobalScopeGlobalMixin.h"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/WindowGlobalMixin.h")
    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
        install(FILES ${GLOBAL_MIXIN_HEADERS} DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/LibWeb/Bindings")
    endif()
    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${GLOBAL_MIXIN_HEADERS})
    list(APPEND LIBWEB_ALL_BINDINGS_SOURCES ${GLOBAL_MIXIN_HEADERS})

    set(LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES_ARGUMENT ${LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES})
    set(LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES_ARGUMENT ${LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES})
    set(LIBWEB_BINDINGS_DEPFILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/LibWebBindings.d")
    if (WIN32)
        list(JOIN LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES "\n" idl_file_list)
        file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/all_idl_files.txt" CONTENT "${idl_file_list}" NEWLINE_STYLE UNIX)
        set(LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES_ARGUMENT "@${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/all_idl_files.txt")

        list(JOIN LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES "\n" parsed_idl_file_list)
        file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/all_parsed_idl_files.txt" CONTENT "${parsed_idl_file_list}" NEWLINE_STYLE UNIX)
        set(LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES_ARGUMENT "@${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/all_parsed_idl_files.txt")
    endif()

    # The bindings of the interfaces implemented in Rust, which libweb_bindings_rust includes.
    set(rust_bindings_source "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Bindings/RustBindings.rs")

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${LIBWEB_ALL_BINDINGS_SOURCES} ${LIBWEB_ALL_COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADERS} ${exposed_interface_sources} ${rust_bindings_source}
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "Bindings"
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${bindings_generator}" -o "Bindings"
                --common-output-path "${LIBWEB_COMMON_BINDINGS_DIRECTORY}"
                --depfile "${LIBWEB_BINDINGS_DEPFILE}"
                ${LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES_ARGUMENT}
        VERBATIM
        COMMENT "Generating LibWeb bindings"
        DEPFILE "${LIBWEB_BINDINGS_DEPFILE}"
        DEPENDS ${bindings_generator_dependencies} ${LIBWEB_ALL_IDL_FILES} ${LIBWEB_ALL_PARSED_IDL_FILES}
    )

    add_custom_target(generate_bindings DEPENDS ${LIBWEB_ALL_BINDINGS_SOURCES} ${LIBWEB_ALL_COMMON_BINDINGS_HEADERS} ${rust_bindings_source})
    add_dependencies(ladybird_codegen_accumulator generate_bindings)
    add_dependencies(${target} generate_bindings)
    add_dependencies(generate_bindings ${generated_idl_targets})

    add_custom_target(generate_exposed_interfaces DEPENDS ${exposed_interface_sources})
    add_dependencies(ladybird_codegen_accumulator generate_exposed_interfaces)
    add_dependencies(${target} generate_exposed_interfaces)
    add_dependencies(generate_exposed_interfaces ${generated_idl_targets})

    set(LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS ${LIBWEB_ALL_GENERATED_HEADERS} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

================================================================================
FILE: Meta/CMake/licenses.cmake
include_guard()

set(licenses_text_file "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/LICENSES.txt")

set(licenses_generator "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/generate-licenses.py")
set(licenses_arguments
    --output "${licenses_text_file}"
    --source-dir "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}"
    --cargo "${RUST_CARGO}"
    --rust-target "${RUST_TARGET_TRIPLE}"
)
set(licenses_dependencies
    "${licenses_generator}"
    "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/LICENSE"
    "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Cargo.lock"
    "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/CMake/lgpl-libraries.txt"
)

if (NOT "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "" AND NOT "${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}" STREQUAL "")
    list(APPEND licenses_arguments
        --vcpkg-installed-dir "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}"
        --vcpkg-triplet "${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}"
    )
    list(APPEND licenses_dependencies "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/vcpkg/status")
endif()

if (NOT ENABLE_NETWORK_DOWNLOADS)
    list(APPEND licenses_arguments --offline)
endif()

# flatpak-builder builds the other modules of the Flatpak, and records their license files for the app.
set(building_flatpak OFF)
if (DEFINED ENV{FLATPAK_ID} AND DEFINED ENV{FLATPAK_DEST})
    set(building_flatpak ON)
    set(flatpak_manifest "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Meta/CMake/flatpak/org.ladybird.Ladybird.json")
    list(APPEND licenses_arguments
        --flatpak-manifest "${flatpak_manifest}"
        --flatpak-licenses-dir "$ENV{FLATPAK_DEST}/share/licenses/$ENV{FLATPAK_ID}"
    )
    list(APPEND licenses_dependencies "${flatpak_manifest}")
endif()

# Build Release publishes the source archives of the LGPL libraries of a distribution build and of the Flatpak, so
# LICENSES.txt points to them.
if ((LADYBIRD_VCPKG_TYPE STREQUAL "distribution" OR building_flatpak) AND NOT LADYBIRD_VERSION STREQUAL "")
    list(APPEND licenses_arguments --release)
endif()

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${licenses_text_file}"
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} "${licenses_generator}" ${licenses_arguments}
    DEPENDS ${licenses_dependencies}
    COMMENT "Collecting the licenses of third-party software"
    JOB_POOL cargo
    VERBATIM
)

# about:licenses decompresses the file itself, and falls back to the uncompressed one.
set(brotli_hints "")
if (NOT "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "" AND NOT "${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}" STREQUAL "")
    list(APPEND brotli_hints "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}/${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}/tools/brotli")
endif()
find_program(BROTLI_EXECUTABLE brotli HINTS ${brotli_hints})

if (BROTLI_EXECUTABLE)
    set(LADYBIRD_LICENSES_FILE "${licenses_text_file}.br")
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${LADYBIRD_LICENSES_FILE}"
        COMMAND "${BROTLI_EXECUTABLE}" --best --force "--output=${LADYBIRD_LICENSES_FILE}" "${licenses_text_file}"
        DEPENDS "${licenses_text_file}"
        COMMENT "Compressing the licenses of third-party software"
        VERBATIM
    )
else()
    message(STATUS "Found no brotli tool, so the licenses of third-party software are installed uncompressed")
    set(LADYBIRD_LICENSES_FILE "${licenses_text_file}")
endif()

add_custom_target(generate_licenses ALL DEPENDS "${LADYBIRD_LICENSES_FILE}")

# The source archives of the LGPL ports, which distribution builds ship as shared libraries, at the addresses that
# LICENSES.txt of a release names, for the Build Release workflow to hand to release-tools.
if (LADYBIRD_VCPKG_TYPE STREQUAL "distribution" AND NOT "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    add_custom_target(third_party_sources
        COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} "${licenses_generator}"
            --source-dir "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}"
            --vcpkg-installed-dir "${VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR}"
            --vcpkg-triplet "${VCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET}"
            --vcpkg-root "$ENV{VCPKG_ROOT}"
            --third-party-sources "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/third-party-sources.tar"
        COMMENT "Packaging the source code of the LGPL ports"
        VERBATIM
    )
endif()

FILE: Meta/CMake/packaging.cmake
# Pass the values below to CPack as they are, rather than unescaping them once more.
set(CPACK_VERBATIM_VARIABLES ON)
set(CPACK_GENERATOR "TGZ")
set(CPACK_STRIP_FILES TRUE)
set(CPACK_ARCHIVE_COMPONENT_INSTALL ON)
set(CPACK_COMPONENTS_ALL js wasm)
set(CPACK_THREADS 0)
if (APPLE)
    if("arm64" IN_LIST CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES AND "x86_64" IN_LIST CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES)
        set(CPACK_SYSTEM_NAME "macOS-universal2")
    else()
        set(CPACK_SYSTEM_NAME "macOS-${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
    endif()
else()
    set(CPACK_SYSTEM_NAME "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}-${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}")
endif()

set(CPACK_ARCHIVE_JS_FILE_NAME "ladybird-js-${CPACK_SYSTEM_NAME}")
set(CPACK_ARCHIVE_WASM_FILE_NAME "ladybird-wasm-${CPACK_SYSTEM_NAME}")

string(JOIN "-" ladybird_package_name ${LADYBIRD_VERSION} ${CPACK_SYSTEM_NAME})
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_FILE_NAME "ladybird-${ladybird_package_name}")
set(CPACK_ARCHIVE_LADYBIRD_RUNTIME_FILE_NAME "ladybird-${ladybird_package_name}")
set(CPACK_ARCHIVE_LADYBIRD_SYMBOLS_FILE_NAME "ladybird-symbols-${ladybird_package_name}")

set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VERSION "${LADYBIRD_BROWSER_VERSION}")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_VENDOR "Ladybird Browser Initiative")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_CONTACT "Ladybird Browser Initiative <contact@ladybird.org>")
set(CPACK_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION
    "Ladybird is a truly independent web browser, using a novel engine based on web standards.")
set(CPACK_PROJECT_CONFIG_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/cpack_project_config.cmake")
set(CPACK_LADYBIRD_PACKAGE_INSTALL_PREFIX "${LADYBIRD_PACKAGE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
set(CPACK_LADYBIRD_RESOURCE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/Lagom")

# The Linux packages are the browser itself and its debug symbols, named like the debug packages of Debian and Fedora.
set(CPACK_DEB_COMPONENT_INSTALL ON)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_FILE_NAME DEB-DEFAULT)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_COMPRESSION_TYPE xz)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_COMPRESSION_LEVEL 9)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_PACKAGE_SECTION web)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_BROWSER_PACKAGE_NAME ladybird)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_BROWSER_DESCRIPTION "${CPACK_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION}")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_BROWSER_PACKAGE_SHLIBDEPS ON)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_BROWSER_PACKAGE_DEPENDS fonts-liberation2)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_BROWSER_PACKAGE_RECOMMENDS "libavcodec63 | libavcodec62 | libavcodec61 | libavcodec60")
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_NAME ladybird-dbgsym)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_SECTION debug)
set(CPACK_DEBIAN_DEBUGSYMBOLS_DESCRIPTION "Debug symbols for Ladybird, which debuggers find by build ID.")

set(CPACK_RPM_COMPONENT_INSTALL ON)
set(CPACK_RPM_FILE_NAME RPM-DEFAULT)
set(CPACK_RPM_PACKAGE_LICENSE "BSD-2-Clause")
set(CPACK_RPM_PACKAGE_RELEASE_DIST ON)
set(CPACK_RPM_BROWSER_PACKAGE_NAME ladybird)
set(CPACK_RPM_BROWSER_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION "${CPACK_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION}")
set(CPACK_RPM_BROWSER_PACKAGE_REQUIRES "liberation-mono-fonts, liberation-sans-fonts, liberation-serif-fonts")
set(CPACK_RPM_BROWSER_PACKAGE_RECOMMENDS libavcodec-free)
set(CPACK_RPM_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_NAME ladybird-debuginfo)
set(CPACK_RPM_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_REQUIRES "ladybird = %{version}-%{release}")
set(CPACK_RPM_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_AUTOREQPROV OFF)
set(CPACK_RPM_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_SUMMARY "Debug symbols for Ladybird")
set(CPACK_RPM_DEBUGSYMBOLS_PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION "Debug symbols for Ladybird, which debuggers find by build ID.")

# The binaries are stripped and their debug symbols laid out by CPack already, so keep rpmbuild from doing it again.
# rpmbuild compresses on a single thread by default, which takes many minutes for packages of our size.
set(CPACK_RPM_SPEC_INSTALL_POST "/bin/true")
set(CPACK_RPM_SPEC_MORE_DEFINE "%define _build_id_links none\n%define _binary_payload w9T0.xzdio")

# The package carries the shared libraries from vcpkg for itself alone, so it must not offer them to the system, nor
# ask the system for them.
include(install_vcpkg_libraries)
if (LINUX AND LADYBIRD_INSTALLS_VCPKG_LIBRARIES)
    ladybird_vcpkg_library_directory(vcpkg_library_dir)
    file(GLOB vcpkg_shared_library_links RELATIVE "${vcpkg_library_dir}" "${vcpkg_library_dir}/*.so")
    list(TRANSFORM vcpkg_shared_library_links REPLACE "\\.so$" "")
    list(TRANSFORM vcpkg_shared_library_links REPLACE "([][+.*()^$?|\\\\])" "\\\\\\\\\\1")
    list(JOIN vcpkg_shared_library_links "|" vcpkg_shared_library_names)
    if (vcpkg_shared_library_names)
        string(APPEND CPACK_RPM_SPEC_MORE_DEFINE "\n%global __provides_exclude ^(${vcpkg_shared_library_names})\\\\.so")
        string(APPEND CPACK_RPM_SPEC_MORE_DEFINE "\n%global __requires_exclude ^(${vcpkg_shared_library_names})\\\\.so")
    endif()
endif()
set(CPACK_RPM_EXCLUDE_FROM_AUTO_FILELIST_ADDITION /opt /usr/lib/debug /usr/lib/debug/.build-id /usr/share/applications
    /usr/share/dbus-1 /usr/share/dbus-1/services /usr/share/icons /usr/share/icons/hicolor
    /usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable /usr/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps /usr/share/metainfo)

include(CPack)

================================================================================
FILE: Meta/CMake/run_quiet.cmake
math(EXPR _last "${CMAKE_ARGC} - 1")
set(CMD "")
set(_seen FALSE)
foreach(i RANGE 0 ${_last})
  if(_seen)
    list(APPEND CMD "${CMAKE_ARGV${i}}")
  elseif(CMAKE_ARGV${i} STREQUAL "--")
    set(_seen TRUE)
  endif()
endforeach()

execute_process(
  COMMAND ${CMD}
  OUTPUT_FILE ${LOG}
  ERROR_FILE  ${LOG}
  RESULT_VARIABLE rc
)
if(NOT rc EQUAL 0)
  if(EXISTS "${LOG}")
    file(READ "${LOG}" out)
    message("${out}")
  endif()
  message(FATAL_ERROR "exec failed (exit ${rc})")
endif()

================================================================================
FILE: Meta/CMake/rust_crate.cmake
set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY JOB_POOLS "${JOB_POOLS};cargo=1")

# Detect the Rust toolchain.
find_program(RUST_CARGO cargo REQUIRED)
find_program(RUST_RUSTC rustc REQUIRED)

if (NOT DEFINED RUSTC_WRAPPER)
    set(RUSTC_WRAPPER "$ENV{RUSTC_WRAPPER}" CACHE FILEPATH "Path to a rustc wrapper program, e.g. sccache")
endif()
if (NOT RUSTC_WRAPPER)
    find_program(SCCACHE_PROGRAM sccache)
    if (SCCACHE_PROGRAM)
        set(RUSTC_WRAPPER "${SCCACHE_PROGRAM}" CACHE FILEPATH "Path to a rustc wrapper program, e.g. sccache" FORCE)
    endif()
endif()

if (NOT DEFINED CACHE{RUST_TARGET_TRIPLE})
    execute_process(COMMAND "${RUST_RUSTC}" -vV OUTPUT_VARIABLE rustc_verbose)
    string(REGEX MATCH "host: ([^\n]+)" _ "${rustc_verbose}")
    string(STRIP "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}" host_triple)
    set(RUST_TARGET_TRIPLE "${host_triple}" CACHE INTERNAL "Rust target triple")
endif()

# Compiler flags shared by Rust libraries, binaries, and tests.
set(RUSTC_TARGET_FLAGS -Dwarnings ${RUSTC_TARGET_CPU_FLAGS} ${RUSTC_TARGET_FRAME_POINTER_FLAGS})
list(JOIN RUSTC_TARGET_FLAGS " " RUSTC_TARGET_FLAGS)

# import_rust_crate(MANIFEST_PATH path/to/Cargo.toml CRATE_NAME name [PANIC_UNWIND] [NO_DEFAULT_FEATURES]
#                   [FEATURES feature...] [KEEP_SYMBOLS symbol...] [ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE=value...])
#
# Builds a Rust static library crate using cargo and creates an IMPORTED target.
# MANIFEST_PATH is relative to CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR.
# NO_DEFAULT_FEATURES builds the crate with only the FEATURES given, without its default ones.
# ENVIRONMENT sets variables in the environment of cargo, for the build script of the crate to read.
# KEEP_SYMBOLS names entry points that only dlsym() reaches. A link only takes the archive members
# something references, and a debug build gives a lone function a member of its own, so these have
# to be asked for or they are left out.
#
# When corrosion supports dependency tracking, we can use corrosion_import_crate() instead of this function. See:
# https://github.com/corrosion-rs/corrosion/issues/206
# https://github.com/corrosion-rs/corrosion/issues/624
function(import_rust_crate)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 0 ARG "PANIC_UNWIND;NO_DEFAULT_FEATURES" "MANIFEST_PATH;CRATE_NAME;FFI_OUTPUT_DIR;FFI_HEADER" "FEATURES;FFI_HEADERS;KEEP_SYMBOLS;ENVIRONMENT")

    if (NOT ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR)
        set(ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
    endif()
    set(ffi_headers ${ARG_FFI_HEADERS})
    if (ARG_FFI_HEADER)
        list(APPEND ffi_headers "${ARG_FFI_HEADER}")
    endif()

    _rust_crate_common_setup(
        MANIFEST_PATH "${ARG_MANIFEST_PATH}"
        CRATE_NAME ${ARG_CRATE_NAME}
        FFI_OUTPUT_DIR "${ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR}"
    )

    # Rust's release profile normally aborts on panic. Crates that parse untrusted input may opt
    # into unwinding so they can contain dependency panics at their FFI boundary.
    if (ARG_PANIC_UNWIND)
        list(APPEND cargo_env "CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_PANIC=unwind")
    endif()
    list(APPEND cargo_env ${ARG_ENVIRONMENT})

    set(cargo_feature_flags "")
    if (ARG_NO_DEFAULT_FEATURES)
        list(APPEND cargo_feature_flags "--no-default-features")
    endif()
    if (ARG_FEATURES)
        list(JOIN ARG_FEATURES "," cargo_features)
        list(APPEND cargo_feature_flags "--features=${cargo_features}")
    endif()

    if (WIN32)
        set(output_lib "${cargo_output_dir}/${ARG_CRATE_NAME}.lib")
        set(depfile "${cargo_output_dir}/${ARG_CRATE_NAME}.d")
    else()
        set(output_lib "${cargo_output_dir}/lib${ARG_CRATE_NAME}.a")
        set(depfile "${cargo_output_dir}/lib${ARG_CRATE_NAME}.d")
    endif()

    _rust_crate_build_command(OUTPUT "${output_lib}" DEPFILE "${depfile}")

    set(ffi_output "")
    if (ffi_headers)
        _rust_crate_sync_ffi_headers(
            CRATE_NAME ${ARG_CRATE_NAME}
            CARGO_OUTPUT "${output_lib}"
            FFI_OUTPUT_DIR "${ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR}"
            FFI_HEADERS ${ffi_headers}
            OUTPUT_VAR ffi_output
        )
    endif()

    add_custom_target(${ARG_CRATE_NAME}-build DEPENDS "${output_lib}" ${ffi_output})

    add_library(${ARG_CRATE_NAME} STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(${ARG_CRATE_NAME} PROPERTIES
            IMPORTED_LOCATION "${output_lib}"
            INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR}"
    )
    add_dependencies(${ARG_CRATE_NAME} ${ARG_CRATE_NAME}-build)

    foreach(symbol IN LISTS ARG_KEEP_SYMBOLS)
        if (APPLE)
            target_link_options(${ARG_CRATE_NAME} INTERFACE "LINKER:-u,_${symbol}")
        elseif (WIN32)
            target_link_options(${ARG_CRATE_NAME} INTERFACE "LINKER:/INCLUDE:${symbol}")
        else()
            target_link_options(${ARG_CRATE_NAME} INTERFACE "LINKER:-u,${symbol}")
        endif()
    endforeach()

    add_rust_crate_initializer(${ARG_CRATE_NAME})
    target_link_libraries(${ARG_CRATE_NAME} INTERFACE $<TARGET_OBJECTS:${ARG_CRATE_NAME}_init>)

    _rust_crate_link_runtime_libraries(${ARG_CRATE_NAME})

    # The archive on its own, without the initializer and the kept symbols of the library that imports the crate, for a
    # target that takes a crate the archive bundles out of it.
    add_library(${ARG_CRATE_NAME}_archive STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(${ARG_CRATE_NAME}_archive PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${output_lib}")
    add_dependencies(${ARG_CRATE_NAME}_archive ${ARG_CRATE_NAME}-build)
    _rust_crate_link_runtime_libraries(${ARG_CRATE_NAME}_archive)
endfunction()

# The cargo invocation that builds the library of the crate _rust_crate_common_setup() was called for, as the custom
# command that produces OUTPUT with the dependencies cargo lists in DEPFILE.
function(_rust_crate_build_command)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 0 ARG "" "OUTPUT;DEPFILE" "")

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${ARG_OUTPUT}"
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
            -DLOG=${cargo_output_dir}/cargo-${ARG_CRATE_NAME}.log
            -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/run_quiet.cmake"
            --
            ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env ${cargo_env} CARGO_TERM_PROGRESS_WHEN=never TERM=dumb
            "${RUST_CARGO}"
                rustc
                --lib
                ${cargo_feature_flags}
                ${cargo_common_flags}
        DEPENDS "${manifest_path}"
            "${workspace_dir}/Cargo.lock" "${workspace_dir}/Cargo.toml"
            "${RUST_RUSTC}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/rust-toolchain.toml"
        DEPFILE "${ARG_DEPFILE}"
        COMMENT "Building Rust crate ${ARG_CRATE_NAME}"
        JOB_POOL cargo
        COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS
    )
endfunction()

# add_rust_crate_initializer(crate)
#
# Defines the object library <crate>_init, whose one object sets up the panic hook and the demangler of the crate in
# whatever links the object. import_rust_crate() defines it for the crate it imports; a target that takes a crate out
# of the archive of another import defines it for that crate.
function(add_rust_crate_initializer crate)
    set(RUST_CRATE_NAME ${crate})
    configure_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/RustCrateInit.cpp.in"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${crate}_init.cpp" @ONLY)

    # A static library only links in the objects that something references, and nothing references the initializer.
    # Putting its object on the link line runs it in whatever executable or shared library links the crate.
    add_library(${crate}_init OBJECT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${crate}_init.cpp")
endfunction()

# What whatever links a Rust static library links with it.
function(_rust_crate_link_runtime_libraries target)
    # Rust allocations go through AK so allocator overrides also apply across the FFI boundary.
    target_link_libraries(${target} INTERFACE AK)

    # Rust staticlibs bundle the standard library, which on Windows depends on system libraries.
    if (WIN32)
        target_link_libraries(${target} INTERFACE kernel32 ntdll Ws2_32 userenv)
    endif()
endfunction()

# _rust_crate_sync_ffi_headers(CRATE_NAME name CARGO_OUTPUT path FFI_OUTPUT_DIR dir FFI_HEADERS header...
#                              OUTPUT_VAR var [DEPENDS target...])
#
# Copies the FFI headers that the build script of CRATE_NAME writes into FFI_OUTPUT_DIR once CARGO_OUTPUT, the library
# of the cargo invocation that runs the build script, is built, and returns the copies in OUTPUT_VAR.
function(_rust_crate_sync_ffi_headers)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 0 ARG "" "CRATE_NAME;CARGO_OUTPUT;FFI_OUTPUT_DIR;OUTPUT_VAR" "FFI_HEADERS;DEPENDS")

    get_filename_component(cargo_output_dir "${ARG_CARGO_OUTPUT}" DIRECTORY)
    set(ffi_output "")
    set(sync_ffi_header_commands "")
    foreach(ffi_header IN LISTS ARG_FFI_HEADERS)
        list(APPEND ffi_output "${ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR}/${ffi_header}")
        list(APPEND sync_ffi_header_commands
            COMMAND
                ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
                    -DCARGO_BUILD_SCRIPT_DIR=${cargo_output_dir}/build
                    -DCRATE_NAME=${ARG_CRATE_NAME}
                    -DFFI_HEADER=${ffi_header}
                    -DFFI_OUTPUT_DIR=${ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR}
                    -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/sync_rust_ffi_header.cmake"
        )
    endforeach()

    # Keep Cargo's output separate from copy_if_different outputs. If they share an edge, Ninja's restat timestamp
    # may predate files generated by build.rs and listed in the Cargo depfile, causing the crate to be incorrectly
    # considered dirty on the next build.
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${ffi_output}
        ${sync_ffi_header_commands}
        DEPENDS "${ARG_CARGO_OUTPUT}" ${ARG_DEPENDS}
        COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS
    )
    set(${ARG_OUTPUT_VAR} ${ffi_output} PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

# sync_rust_crate_ffi_headers(CRATE_NAME name PRODUCED_BY crate FFI_OUTPUT_DIR dir FFI_HEADERS header...)
#
# Copies the FFI headers that the build script of CRATE_NAME writes into FFI_OUTPUT_DIR, for a crate that is built as a
# dependency of PRODUCED_BY, a crate import_rust_crate() imported, rather than imported itself. The copies are made once
# the import's archive is, by the target <CRATE_NAME>-ffi-headers, which whatever compiles against the headers depends
# on.
function(sync_rust_crate_ffi_headers)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 0 ARG "" "CRATE_NAME;PRODUCED_BY;FFI_OUTPUT_DIR" "FFI_HEADERS")

    get_target_property(producer_archive ${ARG_PRODUCED_BY} IMPORTED_LOCATION)
    _rust_crate_sync_ffi_headers(
        CRATE_NAME ${ARG_CRATE_NAME}
        CARGO_OUTPUT "${producer_archive}"
        DEPENDS ${ARG_PRODUCED_BY}-build
        FFI_OUTPUT_DIR "${ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR}"
        FFI_HEADERS ${ARG_FFI_HEADERS}
        OUTPUT_VAR ffi_output
    )
    add_custom_target(${ARG_CRATE_NAME}-ffi-headers DEPENDS ${ffi_output})
endfunction()

# generate_rust_ffi_headers(MANIFEST_PATH path/to/Cargo.toml CRATE_NAME name FFI_OUTPUT_DIR dir FFI_HEADERS header...)
#
# Builds a crate whose build script writes FFI headers, and nothing else links, and copies the headers into
# FFI_OUTPUT_DIR by the target <name>-ffi-headers, which whatever compiles against them depends on. Such a crate lets
# the C++ that includes the headers of a large crate wait for the headers alone rather than for the crate. It is built
# in the directory of the crates import_rust_crate() builds, so it shares their builds of its dependencies.
function(generate_rust_ffi_headers)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 0 ARG "" "MANIFEST_PATH;CRATE_NAME;FFI_OUTPUT_DIR" "FFI_HEADERS")

    _rust_crate_common_setup(
        MANIFEST_PATH "${ARG_MANIFEST_PATH}"
        CRATE_NAME ${ARG_CRATE_NAME}
    )
    set(cargo_feature_flags "")
    set(output_lib "${cargo_output_dir}/lib${ARG_CRATE_NAME}.rlib")
    _rust_crate_build_command(OUTPUT "${output_lib}" DEPFILE "${cargo_output_dir}/lib${ARG_CRATE_NAME}.d")

    _rust_crate_sync_ffi_headers(
        CRATE_NAME ${ARG_CRATE_NAME}
        CARGO_OUTPUT "${output_lib}"
        FFI_OUTPUT_DIR "${ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR}"
        FFI_HEADERS ${ARG_FFI_HEADERS}
        OUTPUT_VAR ffi_output
    )
    add_custom_target(${ARG_CRATE_NAME}-ffi-headers DEPENDS ${ffi_output})
endfunction()

# build_rust_binary(MANIFEST_PATH path/to/Cargo.toml CRATE_NAME name BINARY_NAME name OUTPUT_PATH_VAR var)
#
# Builds a Rust binary crate target using cargo and exposes the copied binary path through OUTPUT_PATH_VAR.
function(build_rust_binary)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 0 ARG "" "MANIFEST_PATH;CRATE_NAME;BINARY_NAME;OUTPUT_NAME;OUTPUT_PATH_VAR;FFI_OUTPUT_DIR" "FEATURES")

    if (NOT ARG_OUTPUT_NAME)
        set(ARG_OUTPUT_NAME "${ARG_BINARY_NAME}")
    endif()

    _rust_crate_common_setup(
        MANIFEST_PATH "${ARG_MANIFEST_PATH}"
        CRATE_NAME ${ARG_CRATE_NAME}
        FFI_OUTPUT_DIR "${ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR}"
        TARGET_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cargo/binaries/${ARG_BINARY_NAME}"
    )

    set(cargo_feature_flags "")
    if (ARG_FEATURES)
        list(JOIN ARG_FEATURES "," cargo_features)
        list(APPEND cargo_feature_flags "--features=${cargo_features}")
    endif()

    set(cargo_binary "${cargo_output_dir}/${ARG_BINARY_NAME}${CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_SUFFIX}")
    set(depfile "${cargo_output_dir}/${ARG_BINARY_NAME}.d")
    set(output_binary "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin/${ARG_OUTPUT_NAME}${CMAKE_EXECUTABLE_SUFFIX}")

    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${cargo_binary}"
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
            -DLOG=${cargo_output_dir}/cargo-${ARG_CRATE_NAME}.log
            -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_FUNCTION_LIST_DIR}/run_quiet.cmake"
            --
            ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env ${cargo_env} CARGO_TERM_PROGRESS_WHEN=never TERM=dumb
            "${RUST_CARGO}"
                rustc
                --bin ${ARG_BINARY_NAME}
                ${cargo_feature_flags}
                ${cargo_common_flags}
        DEPENDS "${manifest_path}"
            "${workspace_dir}/Cargo.lock" "${workspace_dir}/Cargo.toml"
            "${RUST_RUSTC}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/rust-toolchain.toml"
        DEPFILE "${depfile}"
        COMMENT "Building Rust binary ${ARG_BINARY_NAME}"
        JOB_POOL cargo
        COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS
    )

    # See the corresponding comment in import_rust_crate(). In addition to avoiding misleading restat timestamps, this
    # lets copy_if_different suppress downstream rebuilds when Cargo recreates an identical binary.
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${output_binary}"
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${cargo_binary}" "${output_binary}"
        DEPENDS "${cargo_binary}"
    )

    add_custom_target(${ARG_BINARY_NAME}-build DEPENDS "${output_binary}")

    if (ARG_OUTPUT_PATH_VAR)
        set(${ARG_OUTPUT_PATH_VAR} "${output_binary}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    endif()
endfunction()

function(test_rust_crate)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 0 ARG "" "MANIFEST_PATH;CRATE_NAME" "ENVIRONMENT")
    _rust_crate_common_setup(
        MANIFEST_PATH "${ARG_MANIFEST_PATH}"
        CRATE_NAME ${ARG_CRATE_NAME}
        TARGET_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cargo/tests/${ARG_CRATE_NAME}"
    )
    list(APPEND cargo_env ${ARG_ENVIRONMENT})
    # Test binaries link OpenSSL themselves where libcrypto_rust is asked to; see its build script.
    if (OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIBRARY)
        list(APPEND cargo_env "LADYBIRD_OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIBRARY=${OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIBRARY}")
    endif()
    # cargo test accepts harness arguments after --, not rustc arguments.
    list(FIND cargo_common_flags "--" rustc_flags_start)
    list(SUBLIST cargo_common_flags 0 ${rustc_flags_start} cargo_test_flags)
    # Unit tests exercise internal invariants even when using optimized build artifacts.
    list(APPEND cargo_env "CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS=true")
    add_custom_target(${ARG_CRATE_NAME}-test
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env ${cargo_env}
            "${RUST_CARGO}" test --lib ${cargo_test_flags}
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
        USES_TERMINAL
        COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS
    )
endfunction()

# Shared cargo setup for Rust build and test targets.
function(_rust_crate_common_setup)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 0 ARG "" "MANIFEST_PATH;CRATE_NAME;FFI_OUTPUT_DIR;TARGET_DIR" "")

    set(manifest_path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${ARG_MANIFEST_PATH}")

    # Find the workspace Cargo.lock to track as a dependency.
    get_filename_component(workspace_dir "${manifest_path}" DIRECTORY)
    while(NOT EXISTS "${workspace_dir}/Cargo.lock")
        get_filename_component(workspace_dir "${workspace_dir}" DIRECTORY)
    endwhile()

    # Build the uppercased and underscored variants of the target triple.
    string(REPLACE "-" "_" target_underscore "${RUST_TARGET_TRIPLE}")
    string(TOUPPER "${target_underscore}" target_upper)

    # Determine the cargo profile and output directory name.
    string(TOUPPER "${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}" build_type_upper)
    if (build_type_upper STREQUAL "DEBUG")
        set(cargo_profile_flag "")
        set(cargo_profile_dir "debug")
    else()
        set(cargo_profile_flag "--release")
        set(cargo_profile_dir "release")
    endif()

    if (ARG_TARGET_DIR)
        set(cargo_target_dir "${ARG_TARGET_DIR}")
    else()
        set(cargo_target_dir "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cargo/build")
    endif()
    set(cargo_output_dir "${cargo_target_dir}/${RUST_TARGET_TRIPLE}/${cargo_profile_dir}")

    # Build environment variables for cargo.
    set(cargo_env
        "CC_${target_underscore}=${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}"
        "CXX_${target_underscore}=${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}"
        "CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC=${RUST_RUSTC}"
    )

    list(APPEND cargo_env "CARGO_TARGET_${target_upper}_RUSTFLAGS=${RUSTC_TARGET_FLAGS}")

    # The optimized builds otherwise leave out every debug assertion, which then runs only in unit tests. A sanitizer
    # build is one that is run to find bugs, so it checks them too.
    if (ENABLE_ADDRESS_SANITIZER OR ENABLE_UNDEFINED_SANITIZER)
        list(APPEND cargo_env "CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS=true")
    endif()

    if (LADYBIRD_GENERATE_SYMBOL_FILES)
        list(APPEND cargo_env "CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG=line-tables-only")
    endif()

    if (RUSTC_WRAPPER)
        list(APPEND cargo_env
            "RUSTC_WRAPPER=${RUSTC_WRAPPER}"
            "CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0"
        )
    endif()

    if (ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR)
        list(APPEND cargo_env "FFI_OUTPUT_DIR=${ARG_FFI_OUTPUT_DIR}")
    endif()

    # The crates of the shared target directory link into libraries that link AK, so the ak crate leaves the math
    # functions to AK rather than compiling a copy of its own.
    if (NOT ARG_TARGET_DIR)
        list(APPEND cargo_env "LADYBIRD_LINKS_AK=1")
    endif()
    list(APPEND cargo_env "LLVM_LIBC_INCLUDE_DIR=${LLVM_LIBC_INCLUDE_DIR}/llvm-libc")

    # On Windows, rustc invokes the linker directly with MSVC-style flags, so we must not override it with a
    # compiler driver like clang-cl.
    if (NOT WIN32)
        list(APPEND cargo_env
            "CARGO_TARGET_${target_upper}_LINKER=${CMAKE_C_COMPILER}"
            "AR_${target_underscore}=${CMAKE_AR}"
        )
    endif()

    if (APPLE AND CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT)
        list(APPEND cargo_env "SDKROOT=${CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT}")
    endif()
    if (APPLE AND CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET)
        list(APPEND cargo_env "MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=${CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET}")
    endif()

    set(cargo_common_flags
        "--target=${RUST_TARGET_TRIPLE}"
        --package ${ARG_CRATE_NAME}
        --manifest-path "${manifest_path}"
        --target-dir "${cargo_target_dir}"
        ${cargo_profile_flag}
        --
        -Cdefault-linker-libraries=yes
        --emit=dep-info
    )

    # Populate the variable names used by the public helpers below.
    set(cargo_common_flags "${cargo_common_flags}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(cargo_env "${cargo_env}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(cargo_output_dir "${cargo_output_dir}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(manifest_path "${manifest_path}" PARENT_SCOPE)
    set(workspace_dir "${workspace_dir}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

FILE: Meta/CMake/sanitizers.cmake
if ((ENABLE_ADDRESS_SANITIZER AND ENABLE_MEMORY_SANITIZER)
    OR (ENABLE_ADDRESS_SANITIZER AND ENABLE_THREAD_SANITIZER)
    OR (ENABLE_MEMORY_SANITIZER AND ENABLE_THREAD_SANITIZER))
    message(FATAL_ERROR "AddressSanitizer, MemorySanitizer, and ThreadSanitizer cannot be enabled together")
endif()

function(get_clang_resource_dir result_dir)
    execute_process(COMMAND ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER} -print-resource-dir
        OUTPUT_VARIABLE CLANG_RESOURCE_DIR OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
    )
    file(TO_CMAKE_PATH "${CLANG_RESOURCE_DIR}" CLANG_RESOURCE_DIR)
    set(${result_dir} "${CLANG_RESOURCE_DIR}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

if (ENABLE_ADDRESS_SANITIZER)
    if (WIN32 AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang$")
        add_cxx_compile_options(-fsanitize=address /clang:-fno-omit-frame-pointer)
        # FIXME: Windows on ARM
        link_libraries(clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.lib -wholearchive:clang_rt.asan_dynamic_runtime_thunk-x86_64.lib)
        get_clang_resource_dir(CLANG_RESOURCE_DIR)
        file(COPY "${CLANG_RESOURCE_DIR}/lib/windows/clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.dll" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
    else()
        add_cxx_compile_options(-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
        add_cxx_link_options(-fsanitize=address)
    endif()
endif()

if (ENABLE_MEMORY_SANITIZER)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fsanitize=memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    add_cxx_link_options(-fsanitize=memory -fsanitize-memory-track-origins)
endif()

if (ENABLE_THREAD_SANITIZER)
    add_cxx_compile_options(-fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    add_cxx_link_options(-fsanitize=thread)
endif()

if (ENABLE_UNDEFINED_SANITIZER)
    if (WIN32 AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang$")
        add_cxx_compile_options(-fsanitize=undefined)
        # FIXME: Windows on ARM
        link_libraries(clang_rt.ubsan_standalone-x86_64.lib clang_rt.ubsan_standalone_cxx-x86_64.lib)
    else()
        add_cxx_compile_options(-fsanitize=undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
        if (UNDEFINED_BEHAVIOR_IS_FATAL)
            add_cxx_compile_options(-fno-sanitize-recover=undefined)
        endif()
        if (APPLE AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang$")
            add_cxx_compile_options(-fno-sanitize=function)
        endif()
        # The LibJS runtime keeps its own class pointer where a C++ cell has its vtable pointer, so vptr checks misfire
        # wherever one of its cells is handled as a GC::Cell.
        add_cxx_compile_options(-fno-sanitize=vptr)
        add_cxx_link_options(-fsanitize=undefined)
    endif()
endif()

FILE: Meta/CMake/setup_ccache.cmake
#
# ccache setup
#

list(APPEND COMPILERS
    "CMAKE_C_COMPILER"
    "CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER"
)
if (LADYBIRD_ENABLE_CCACHE)
    find_program(CCACHE_PROGRAM ccache)
endif()
foreach(compiler ${COMPILERS})
    if (LADYBIRD_ENABLE_CCACHE AND CCACHE_PROGRAM)
        get_filename_component(compiler_path "${${compiler}}" REALPATH)
        get_filename_component(compiler_name "${compiler_path}" NAME)
        if (NOT ${compiler_name} MATCHES "ccache")
            set("${compiler}_LAUNCHER" "${CCACHE_PROGRAM}" CACHE FILEPATH "Path to a compiler launcher program, e.g. ccache")
        endif()
    elseif (NOT LADYBIRD_ENABLE_CCACHE AND DEFINED CACHE{${compiler}_LAUNCHER})
        string(REGEX MATCH "^[^;]*" launcher_program "$CACHE{${compiler}_LAUNCHER}")
        get_filename_component(launcher_name "${launcher_program}" NAME)
        if (launcher_name STREQUAL "ccache" OR launcher_name STREQUAL "ccache.exe"
            OR (CCACHE_PROGRAM AND launcher_program STREQUAL CCACHE_PROGRAM))
            unset("${compiler}_LAUNCHER" CACHE)
        endif()
    endif()
endforeach()

================================================================================
FILE: Meta/CMake/sync_rust_ffi_header.cmake
#[[
 * Copyright (c) 2026-present, the Ladybird developers.
 *
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-2-Clause
]]

if (NOT DEFINED CRATE_NAME OR NOT DEFINED CARGO_BUILD_SCRIPT_DIR OR NOT DEFINED FFI_HEADER OR NOT DEFINED FFI_OUTPUT_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "sync_rust_ffi_header.cmake requires CRATE_NAME, CARGO_BUILD_SCRIPT_DIR, FFI_HEADER, and FFI_OUTPUT_DIR")
endif()

if (FFI_HEADER STREQUAL "")
    return()
endif()

# Cargo writes a build script's output under <crate>-<hash>/ up to 1.98, and under <crate>/<hash>/run/ after that. A
# build directory reused across a Cargo upgrade holds both, so the newest root-output file decides.
file(GLOB root_output_files
    "${CARGO_BUILD_SCRIPT_DIR}/${CRATE_NAME}-*/root-output"
    "${CARGO_BUILD_SCRIPT_DIR}/${CRATE_NAME}/*/run/root-output")

set(latest_source_header "")
set(latest_root_output_file "")

foreach(root_output_file IN LISTS root_output_files)
    file(READ "${root_output_file}" out_dir)
    string(STRIP "${out_dir}" out_dir)

    set(source_header "${out_dir}/${FFI_HEADER}")
    if (NOT EXISTS "${source_header}")
        continue()
    endif()

    # IS_NEWER_THAN compares the full modification times, and holds for equal ones, so a tie goes to the file that
    # sorts later: the newer layout's, since "/" sorts after "-".
    if (latest_source_header STREQUAL "" OR "${root_output_file}" IS_NEWER_THAN "${latest_root_output_file}")
        set(latest_source_header "${source_header}")
        set(latest_root_output_file "${root_output_file}")
    endif()
endforeach()

if (NOT latest_source_header STREQUAL "")
    get_filename_component(destination_header_directory "${FFI_OUTPUT_DIR}/${FFI_HEADER}" DIRECTORY)
    file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${destination_header_directory}")
    execute_process(
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E copy_if_different "${latest_source_header}" "${FFI_OUTPUT_DIR}/${FFI_HEADER}"
        COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY
    )
    return()
endif()

message(FATAL_ERROR "Failed to find ${FFI_HEADER} in Cargo build output for ${CRATE_NAME}")

================================================================================
FILE: Meta/CMake/system_ffmpeg_headers.cmake
# The Vulkan video decoder reaches into FFmpeg's structs, which are laid out differently in each major version. These
# are the headers of the releases other than the one Ladybird is built against, so that it can do so in a system
# FFmpeg of any of those versions.

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/utils.cmake)

set(SYSTEM_FFMPEG_HEADERS_CACHE_PATH "${LADYBIRD_CACHE_DIR}/FFmpegHeaders" CACHE PATH "Download location for FFmpeg release archives")

# The libavcodec major version, the release whose headers stand for it, and the SHA-256 of that release's archive.
set(system_ffmpeg_releases
    "60|6.1.6|d4fcb164028dd3beee5d92c0ac72e46aac6973c75ea12dc14de07bf8f407370a"
    "61|7.1.5|de668509caf9e35e3cd162473441fdb29538c6d96ed080292b3cf9e6fc5d558f"
    "62|8.1.3|7138d28c96d9d3e3af4ee3d8cad72741f8ffb40da90c1112235dea3ecd3178a3"
    "63|9.0.2|8c3850283eb25fa026482078a04051e0be17347b09ef81a0849bec15a96e002e"
)

# pkg-config's answer for the version is cached from the first configuration, so the headers themselves say which
# version Ladybird is built against.
find_file(system_ffmpeg_built_against_version_header libavcodec/version_major.h HINTS ${AVCODEC_INCLUDE_DIRS} NO_CACHE REQUIRED)
file(STRINGS "${system_ffmpeg_built_against_version_header}" system_ffmpeg_built_against_major REGEX "#define LIBAVCODEC_VERSION_MAJOR")
string(REGEX MATCH "[0-9]+" system_ffmpeg_built_against_major "${system_ffmpeg_built_against_major}")

set(SYSTEM_FFMPEG_HEADER_MAJORS "")
set(system_ffmpeg_missing_releases "")
foreach(release IN LISTS system_ffmpeg_releases)
    string(REPLACE "|" ";" release "${release}")
    list(GET release 0 major)
    list(GET release 1 version)
    list(GET release 2 sha256)
    if (major STREQUAL system_ffmpeg_built_against_major)
        continue()
    endif()

    set(archive "${SYSTEM_FFMPEG_HEADERS_CACHE_PATH}/ffmpeg-${version}.tar.xz")
    if (NOT EXISTS "${archive}" AND NOT ENABLE_NETWORK_DOWNLOADS)
        list(APPEND system_ffmpeg_missing_releases "${version}")
        continue()
    endif()
    download_file("https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-${version}.tar.xz" "${archive}" SHA256 "${sha256}")

    set(include_directory "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/SystemFFmpegHeaders/${version}")
    if (NOT EXISTS "${include_directory}/libavutil/avconfig.h")
        file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${include_directory}" "${include_directory}.tmp")
        file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT
            INPUT "${archive}"
            DESTINATION "${include_directory}.tmp"
            PATTERNS "ffmpeg-${version}/libavcodec/*.h" "ffmpeg-${version}/libavutil/*.h"
        )
        file(RENAME "${include_directory}.tmp/ffmpeg-${version}" "${include_directory}")
        file(REMOVE_RECURSE "${include_directory}.tmp")
        # FFmpeg's build generates this header, which only describes the machine.
        if (CMAKE_CXX_BYTE_ORDER STREQUAL "BIG_ENDIAN")
            set(system_ffmpeg_big_endian 1)
        else()
            set(system_ffmpeg_big_endian 0)
        endif()
        file(WRITE "${include_directory}/libavutil/avconfig.h" "#define AV_HAVE_BIGENDIAN ${system_ffmpeg_big_endian}\n#define AV_HAVE_FAST_UNALIGNED 0\n")
    endif()

    list(APPEND SYSTEM_FFMPEG_HEADER_MAJORS "${major}")
    set(SYSTEM_FFMPEG_${major}_INCLUDE_DIRECTORY "${include_directory}")
endforeach()

if (system_ffmpeg_missing_releases)
    list(JOIN system_ffmpeg_missing_releases ", " system_ffmpeg_missing_releases)
    message(WARNING "The archives of FFmpeg ${system_ffmpeg_missing_releases} are not in ${SYSTEM_FFMPEG_HEADERS_CACHE_PATH}, and downloads are disabled. Hardware video decoding through a system FFmpeg of those versions will be unavailable.")
endif()

FILE: Meta/CMake/targets.cmake
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/utils.cmake)

# ladybird_generate_export_header(name fs_name [BASE_NAME base])
#
# BASE_NAME names the export header's macros after a library other than the target, for a target that compiles the
# objects of a library, as LibJSObjects compiles LibJS's.
function(ladybird_generate_export_header name fs_name)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 2 EXPORT_HEADER "" "BASE_NAME" "")
    # Temporary helper to allow libraries to opt-in to using X_API macros
    # to export symbols required by external consumers. This allows the codebase
    # to gradually slowly migrate instead of an all-or-nothing approach.
    if (NOT WIN32)
        target_compile_options(${name}
            PRIVATE
                "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fvisibility=hidden>"
                "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-fvisibility=hidden>"
        )
    else()
        set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS OFF)
    endif()
    include(GenerateExportHeader)
    string(TOUPPER ${fs_name} fs_name_upper)
    set(base_name "")
    if (EXPORT_HEADER_BASE_NAME)
        set(base_name BASE_NAME ${EXPORT_HEADER_BASE_NAME})
    endif()
    generate_export_header(${name} ${base_name} EXPORT_MACRO_NAME ${fs_name_upper}_API EXPORT_FILE_NAME "Export.h")
    # NB: The IPC compiler exports the codecs it generates for the library with this.
    set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES LADYBIRD_EXPORT_MACRO ${fs_name_upper}_API)
endfunction()

# What the objects of every library are compiled and linked with, whether the library is a target of its own or an
# object library another one takes in: the clang plugin, AK, the warnings of the platform, and on Windows the
# pthread and mman shims.
function(ladybird_library_setup name)
    target_link_libraries(${name} PUBLIC GenericClangPlugin)
    if ((APPLE AND NOT IOS) OR (LINUX AND NOT ANDROID))
        target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANG_AND_ID:CXX,Clang,AppleClang>:-Wexit-time-destructors>)
    endif()

    if (NOT "${name}" STREQUAL "AK")
        target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE AK)
    endif()

    if (WIN32)
        target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE ${PTHREAD_INCLUDE_DIR})
        target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE ${PTHREAD_LIBRARY})

        target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE ${MMAN_INCLUDE_DIR})
        target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE ${MMAN_LIBRARY})
    endif()
endfunction()

# The headers of Libraries/Lib${library}, for whatever consumes an installed Lagom through the target.
function(ladybird_install_library_headers name library)
    # FIXME: Clean these up so that we don't need so many include dirs
    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS)
        target_include_directories(${name} INTERFACE
                $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/Services>
                $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/Libraries>
                $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/Services>
        )
        install(
                DIRECTORY "${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}/Libraries/Lib${library}"
                COMPONENT Lagom_Development
                DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}
                FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.h"
        )
    endif()
endfunction()

function(ladybird_generate_dsym target_name)
    if (APPLE AND LADYBIRD_GENERATE_DSYM)
        add_custom_command(TARGET ${target_name} POST_BUILD
            COMMAND dsymutil -o "$<TARGET_FILE:${target_name}>.dSYM" "$<TARGET_FILE:${target_name}>"
            COMMENT "Generating dSYM for ${target_name}"
        )
    endif()
endfunction()

if (WIN32 AND BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
    # Executable link commands also deploy runtime DLLs, including vcpkg's app-local dependencies.
    # They share an output directory, so concurrent deployments can open a DLL while another writes it.
    set_property(GLOBAL APPEND PROPERTY JOB_POOLS windows_dll_deployment=1)
endif()

function(ladybird_copy_runtime_dlls target_name)
    if (WIN32 AND BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
        set_property(TARGET ${target_name} PROPERTY JOB_POOL_LINK windows_dll_deployment)
        add_custom_command(TARGET ${target_name} POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
                -E copy_if_different
                $<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:${target_name}>
                $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:${target_name}>
            COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS
        )
    endif()
endfunction()

# https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/build/reference/subsystem-specify-subsystem?view=msvc-170
# Add /SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS linker flag and defines the default WinMain. This makes the executable target not launch with a console
function(ladybird_subsystem_windows target_name)
    if(WIN32)
        set_target_properties(${target_name} PROPERTIES
            WIN32_EXECUTABLE TRUE
            LINK_FLAGS "/ENTRY:mainCRTStartup"
        )
    endif()
endfunction()

function(ladybird_windows_bin target_name)
    cmake_parse_arguments(LAGOM_WINDOWS_BIN "CONSOLE" "" "" ${ARGN})
    ladybird_copy_runtime_dlls(${target_name})
    if (NOT LAGOM_WINDOWS_BIN_CONSOLE)
        ladybird_subsystem_windows(${target_name})
    else()
        set_target_properties(${target_name} PROPERTIES
            WIN32_EXECUTABLE FALSE
        )
    endif()
endfunction()

function(ladybird_bin name)
    add_executable(${name} ${SOURCES} ${GENERATED_SOURCES})
    add_executable(Lagom::${name} ALIAS ${name})
    target_link_libraries(${name} PUBLIC GenericClangPlugin)
    ladybird_windows_bin(${name})
    ladybird_generate_dsym(${name})
    install(
            TARGETS ${target_name}
            EXPORT LagomTargets
            RUNTIME #
            COMPONENT Lagom_Runtime
            LIBRARY #
            COMPONENT Lagom_Runtime
            NAMELINK_COMPONENT Lagom_Development
            ARCHIVE #
            COMPONENT Lagom_Development
            INCLUDES #
            DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}
    )
    ladybird_generated_sources(${name})
endfunction()

function(ladybird_lib name fs_name)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 2 LADYBIRD_LIB "EXPLICIT_SYMBOL_EXPORT" "TYPE" "")
    string(REPLACE "Lib" "" library ${name})
    if (NOT LADYBIRD_LIB_TYPE)
        set(LADYBIRD_LIB_TYPE "")
    endif()

    add_library(${name} ${LADYBIRD_LIB_TYPE} ${SOURCES} ${GENERATED_SOURCES})
    set_target_properties(
            ${name} PROPERTIES
            VERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION}"
            SOVERSION "${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR}"
            EXPORT_NAME ${library}
            OUTPUT_NAME lagom-${fs_name}
    )
    target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE ${LIBS})
    ladybird_library_setup(${name})

    if (NOT LADYBIRD_LIB_TYPE STREQUAL "STATIC")
        ladybird_generate_dsym(${name})
    endif()

    ladybird_install_library_headers(${name} ${library})
    add_lagom_library_install_rules(${name} ALIAS_NAME ${library})
    ladybird_generated_sources(${name})
    if (LADYBIRD_LIB_EXPLICIT_SYMBOL_EXPORT)
        ladybird_generate_export_header(${name} ${fs_name})
    endif()
    if (ENABLE_INSTALL_HEADERS AND GENERATED_IPC AND LADYBIRD_LIB_EXPLICIT_SYMBOL_EXPORT)
        install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Export.h" DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/${name}")
    endif()
endfunction()

function(ladybird_test test_src sub_dir)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 2 LADYBIRD_TEST "NO_TEST" "CUSTOM_MAIN;NAME" "LIBS")
    if (NOT LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME)
        get_filename_component(LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME ${test_src} NAME_WE)
    endif()
    if (NOT LADYBIRD_TEST_CUSTOM_MAIN)
        set(LADYBIRD_TEST_CUSTOM_MAIN "$<TARGET_OBJECTS:LibTestMain>")
    endif()
    add_executable(${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME} ${test_src})
    target_link_libraries(${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME} PRIVATE AK LibCore LibFileSystem LibTest ${LADYBIRD_TEST_CUSTOM_MAIN} ${LADYBIRD_TEST_LIBS})
    ladybird_windows_bin(${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME} CONSOLE)
    ladybird_generate_dsym(${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME})

    if (WIN32)
        target_include_directories(${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME} PRIVATE ${PTHREAD_INCLUDE_DIR})
        target_link_libraries(${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME} PRIVATE ${PTHREAD_LIBRARY})

        target_include_directories(${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME} PRIVATE ${MMAN_INCLUDE_DIR})
        target_link_libraries(${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME} PRIVATE ${MMAN_LIBRARY})
    endif()

    if (NOT LADYBIRD_TEST_NO_TEST)
        add_test(
            NAME ${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME}
            COMMAND ${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME}
            WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        )
    endif()
endfunction()

function(ladybird_python_test test_src)
    cmake_parse_arguments(PARSE_ARGV 1 LADYBIRD_TEST "" "NAME;TIMEOUT;PYTHON_EXECUTABLE" "ARGS;ENVIRONMENT")
    if (NOT LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME)
        get_filename_component(LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME ${test_src} NAME_WE)
    endif()
    if (NOT DEFINED LADYBIRD_TEST_TIMEOUT)
        set(LADYBIRD_TEST_TIMEOUT 120)
    endif()
    if (NOT LADYBIRD_TEST_PYTHON_EXECUTABLE)
        set(LADYBIRD_TEST_PYTHON_EXECUTABLE "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}")
    endif()
    list(PREPEND LADYBIRD_TEST_ENVIRONMENT "LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR=${LADYBIRD_SOURCE_DIR}")

    get_filename_component(test_src "${test_src}" ABSOLUTE BASE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

    add_test(
        NAME ${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME}
        COMMAND "${LADYBIRD_TEST_PYTHON_EXECUTABLE}" "${test_src}" ${LADYBIRD_TEST_ARGS}
    )
    set_tests_properties(${LADYBIRD_TEST_NAME} PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT "${LADYBIRD_TEST_TIMEOUT}"
        ENVIRONMENT "${LADYBIRD_TEST_ENVIRONMENT}"
    )
endfunction()

# Each library's sources are added directly to its test executable.
function(ladybird_test_suite sub_dir)
    string(REPLACE "/" "" suite_name "Test${sub_dir}")
    ladybird_test("" "${sub_dir}" NAME "${suite_name}" ${ARGN})
endfunction()

function(ladybird_utility name)
    cmake_parse_arguments(LADYBIRD_UTILITY "" "" "SOURCES;LIBS" ${ARGN})

    add_executable("${name}" ${LADYBIRD_UTILITY_SOURCES})
    target_link_libraries("${name}" PRIVATE AK LibCore ${LADYBIRD_UTILITY_LIBS})
    ladybird_generate_dsym(${name})
endfunction()

if (NOT TARGET ladybird_codegen_accumulator)
    # Meta target to run all code-gen steps in the build.
    add_custom_target(ladybird_codegen_accumulator)
endif()

# Copyright (c) 2022, Andrew Kaster <akaster@serenityos.org>

if (NOT APPLE AND NOT ANDROID AND NOT WIN32 AND NOT LAGOM_USE_LINKER)
    find_program(LLD_LINKER NAMES "ld.lld")
    if (LLD_LINKER)
        message(STATUS "Using LLD to link Lagom.")
        set(LAGOM_USE_LINKER "lld" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
    else()
        find_program(MOLD_LINKER NAMES "ld.mold")
        if (MOLD_LINKER)
            message(STATUS "Using mold to link Lagom.")
            set(LAGOM_USE_LINKER "mold" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

if(WIN32 AND NOT LAGOM_USE_LINKER)
    # We do not need to check for its presence.
    # We know it is there with the installation of clang-cl which we require.
    set(LAGOM_USE_LINKER "lld" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

if (LAGOM_USE_LINKER)
    # FIXME: Move to only setting CMAKE_LINKER_TYPE once we drop support for CMake < 3.29
    # NOTE: CMAKE_LINKER_TYPE doesn't work on BSDs on CMake < 4.2
    if (CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL 3.29 AND NOT BSD)
        string(TOUPPER ${LAGOM_USE_LINKER} linker_type)
        set(CMAKE_LINKER_TYPE ${linker_type})
    else()
        set(LINKER_FLAG "-fuse-ld=${LAGOM_USE_LINKER}")
        set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${LINKER_FLAG}")
        set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS} ${LINKER_FLAG}")
        set(CMAKE_MODULE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_MODULE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${LINKER_FLAG}")
    endif()
endif()

if (LAGOM_LINK_POOL_SIZE)
    set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY JOB_POOLS link_pool=${LAGOM_LINK_POOL_SIZE})
    set(CMAKE_JOB_POOL_LINK link_pool CACHE STRING "Linking job pool")
endif()
